new_roles.title: Director - Service Operations
new_roles.description:
As the **Director of Service Operations** at Lumos, you'll play a critical leadership role in delivering reliable fiber connectivity and an exceptional customer experience across our growing markets. You'll lead and develop regional operations teams, oversee service installations and maintenance, and drive the performance, safety, and efficiency of our field operations.

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact as Lumos continues to expand, combining strategic leadership with hands-on operational expertise to strengthen service delivery, improve processes, and build high-performing teams that support our customers and continued growth.

This is a remote position supporting Service Operations across the Midwest region, with a preference for candidates located within a Lumos market in **Ohio, Indiana, or Kentucky**. Regional travel is required.

**Why Lumos:**

Lumos is transforming the future of connectivity by building one of the nation's fastest-growing 100% Fiber Optic networks. Through T-Fiber, our joint venture with T-Mobile, we're working toward a shared goal of connecting 12 to 15 million homes by 2030 while expanding access to reliable, high-speed internet in the communities we serve.

Here, you'll find more than a job, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, take ownership of your work, and help shape how we grow. We move quickly, collaborate across teams, and believe the best ideas come from people who are curious, solutions-oriented, and ready to build what's next.

**What You'll Do:**

* Lead, coach, and develop regional Service Operations managers and teams, fostering accountability, collaboration, and a strong customer-first culture.
* Oversee service installations, maintenance, and field operations across assigned markets, ensuring consistent quality, safety, and operational performance.
* Establish and monitor KPIs, SLAs, and customer experience metrics to drive efficiency, service reliability, and continuous improvement.
* Develop and execute operational strategies that support market expansion, service delivery objectives, and long-term business growth.
* Manage department budgets, resources, and operational projects to ensure effective planning, execution, and cost management.
* Oversee vendor and contractor performance, including negotiations, service expectations, and accountability for operational results.
* Serve as a key escalation point for complex customer and operational challenges, driving timely resolution and improvements to the customer experience.
* Partner across Network Operations, Engineering, Construction, Customer Care, and other teams to improve workflows, strengthen service delivery, and support business objectives.
* Establish and maintain operational policies, procedures, and safety standards while identifying opportunities to improve processes and scale operations.

**What You'll Bring:**

* 7+ years of experience in telecommunications service operations, field operations, or a related area.
* Proven experience leading geographically dispersed teams, developing managers, and driving operational performance across multiple markets.
* Strong understanding of telecommunications service installation, maintenance, network operations, and customer service delivery.
* Experience managing operational budgets, vendor relationships, contractor performance, and service-level agreements.
* Ability to analyze KPIs, operational performance, and customer satisfaction metrics to identify trends and drive improvements.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and operational software platforms, with the ability to adapt to new systems and technologies.
* A proactive, solutions-oriented approach with the ability to work independently and lead effectively in a fast-paced environment.

**What Makes You a Great Fit:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Bachelor's degree in business, telecommunications, engineering, or a related field.
* Direct experience in the fiber broadband or FTTH industry, including distributed and centralized split network architectures.
* Knowledge of central office infrastructure, network equipment, and telecommunications facilities.
* Experience improving customer satisfaction, NPS scores, and operational efficiency across multiple markets.
* A track record of developing high-performing teams, improving operational processes, and supporting growth in a scaling organization.
* A collaborative, hands-on leadership style with the ability to balance strategic priorities with day-to-day operational execution.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Frequently operates a computer, phone, and standard office tools.
* Ability to travel to properties and regional offices as needed.
* Near-constant use of sight, speech, hearing, comprehension, and reasoning.
* Must be able to sit or remain in a stationary position for extended periods.

**Benefits & Perks:**

Our commitment to communities includes recruiting and rewarding the Lumos team members who are working together to build a brighter tomorrow.

We have:

* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.
* Competitive compensation packages, including bonus options for eligible positions.
* Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays.
* Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs).
* 100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with access to professional support for life's challenges.
* 401K plan w/ up to 5% employer contribution and a self-directed brokerage option.
* Wellness program offering education and cash incentives for gym attendance and nutrition programs.
* Employee referral bonuses.
* Discounts on Lumos Fiber Internet for employees who live in our service areas.
* Discounts on T-Mobile wireless service and select features for lines.

**Applicant Eligibility Notice:** 
Applicants must be at least eighteen (18) years of age at the time of application.

**At Lumos we recruit, hire, employ, train, promote, and compensate individuals based on job-related qualifications and abilities. We have a longstanding policy of providing a work environment that respects the dignity and worth of each individual and is free from all forms of employment discrimination, including harassment, because of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. We will provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals** **with disabilities or based on a sincerely held religious belief, in accordance with applicable laws.**

new_roles.title: Director of Operations – Fire & Life Safety (FLS)
new_roles.description:
The Director of Operations - Fire & Life Safety (FLS), is responsible for providing operational leadership, governance, and support across Bosch Building Technologies North America (Bosch BT NA) FLS projects & branch operations. Reporting to the Senior Vice President of Operations, this role partners closely with Branch Managers, Operations Managers, and Project Teams to drive consistent project execution, improve forecast accuracy, reduce operational risk, and strengthen financial performance.

The Director of Operations - Fire & Life Safety serves as a strategic operational leader focused on project health, resource optimization, excellence, and continuous improvement across the FLS business. The role ensures alignment to company standards and operational best practices while supporting branch teams in delivering successful outcomes for customers and stakeholders.

**Responsibilities:**

**Operational Leadership & Branch Support**

* Partner with Branch Managers and Operations Leaders to support execution of business objectives.
* Conduct regular branch operational reviews to evaluate project health, financial performance, staffing, backlog, and forecast accuracy.
* Provide leadership and guidance for complex operational issues and escalated project concerns.
* Support organizational consistency across all FLS operations.

**Project Governance & Risk Management**

* Oversee project review programs throughout the project lifecycle.
* Identify operational, contractual, financial, and execution risks on large projects.
* Facilitate risk mitigation strategies and recovery planning.
* Support margin improvement initiatives and reduction of project deviations.
* Ensure project controls and governance standards are consistently followed.
* Drive consistent execution standards across all FLS operations.

**Financial & Operational Performance**

* Review project forecasts, earned revenue, gross margin performance, labor utilization, and backlog health.
* Partner with branch leadership on annual planning, budgeting, and forecasting activities.
* Drive accountability for operational KPIs and project financial performance.
* Improve forecast accuracy and operational predictability

**Process Standardization & Continuous Improvement**

* Implement operational best practices and playbooks.
* Support standardization of project execution methodologies.
* Identify opportunities for productivity improvements and workflow efficiencies.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives across assigned branches.

**Cross Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Engineering, Sales, Procurement, Service, and Finance teams.
* Support seamless project transitions from sales through execution and into service.
* Ensure operational alignment with strategic organizational objectives.

**Health, Safety & Compliance**

* Promote a culture of operational excellence and safety.
* Ensure compliance with customer requirements, company policies, and regulatory standards.

**Supervisor Duties:**

In accordance with applicable Company policies/procedures and Federal/State laws, will perform the following supervisory responsibilities: planning, assigning, and directing work; coaching and appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

**Professional Competencies:**

* Resilience: Ability to maintain composure and adapt swiftly amidst uncertainty and rapid changes.
* Strategic Agility: Capacity to analyze situations critically and make prompt, well-informed decisions, considering diverse scenarios and potential outcomes.
* Entrepreneurial Mindset: Willingness to take calculated risks and explore innovative solutions to drive growth and capitalize on opportunities.
* Collaborative Leadership: Skill in fostering collaboration and teamwork across diverse stakeholders and departments to achieve common objectives.
* Resourcefulness: Ability to effectively leverage available resources, networks, and expertise to address challenges and capitalize on synergies.
* Attention to Detail: Capability to manage intricate details and nuances, ensuring thorough planning and execution of strategic initiatives.
* Emotional Intelligence: Aptitude in understanding and managing emotions to navigate sensitive situations, negotiate effectively, and build strong relationships.
* Adaptability: Willingness and ability to adjust strategies and approaches in response to evolving market dynamics, regulatory requirements, or unexpected developments.
* Clear Communication: Strong communication skills to articulate complex ideas, influence stakeholders, and navigate challenging conversations.
* Ethical Integrity: Commitment to upholding high ethical standards and integrity, ensuring transparency and compliance with regulations and corporate governance principles.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 8 - 10 years of leadership experience within Fire & Life Safety operations, project management, or construction operations.
* Strong working knowledge of Fire & Life Safety systems, including fire alarm, detection, notification, emergency communications, and building-system interfaces, with strong understanding of applicable NFPA, NEC, IBC/IFC, and UL codes and requirements.
* Proven experience managing large project portfolios.
* Expertise in forecasting, financial management, project controls, and operational leadership.
* Experience with ERP and project management platforms.
* A valid Driver's License and ability to pass pre-employment screens

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business, or equivalent experience
* Previous and progressive experience in Operational leadership within Building Automation Systems projects & programs
* Experience developing and implementing national operational standards, including SOPs, domain specific operational playbooks, and process guidelines
* Ability to collaborate cross functionally with Engineering, Sales, Procurement, Service, and Finance teams to drive operation initiatives
* Harmonization of Operations Department through Merger & Acquisition activity
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or similar ERP platforms

**Key Success Metrics:**

* Project Margin Performance
* Forecast Accuracy
* Gross Margin Performance
* Schedule Adherence
* Labor Productivity
* Risk Reduction
* Backlog Health
* Customer Satisfaction
* Safety Performance

**Physical Demands:**

In general, the following physical demands are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job.

* Must be able to effectively communicate in English, (ie see, hear, speak and write clearly) in order to communicate with colleagues and/or customers
* Manual dexterity required for occasional reaching, lifting of light office objects, and operating office equipment
* Sitting, standing, walking in office environments and construction sites
* The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and may be required to work at heights over 1.8m (6 feet)

**Working Conditions:**

In general, the following conditions of the work environment are representative of those that an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.

* The office is clean, orderly, properly lighted and ventilated. Noise levels are considered low to moderate
* Will be required to be on site with customers or contractors, with or without colleagues to manage the expectations and deliverables. Sites range from general office environments to new construction.
* Driving to customer sites is required
* Overnight travel will be required

new_roles.description:
**Foundation Risk Partners****, one of the fastest growing insurance brokerage and consulting firms in the US, is adding a** ***Director of Operations-Insurance*** **to their team in** ***Lakeland, FL.***

**Job Summary:**

The Commercial Lines Operations Leader is responsible for overseeing the operational effectiveness, service delivery, and strategic execution of commercial lines insurance processes. This role ensures alignment with business goals, regulatory compliance, and a high standard of customer and broker satisfaction. The leader will drive continuous improvement, operational efficiency, and team performance across underwriting support, policy servicing, and client onboarding.

**Essential Functions:**

* **Operational Leadership:** 
 Lead day-to-day operations for commercial lines, ensuring timely and accurate processing of policies, endorsements, renewals, and cancellations.
* **Process Optimization:** 
 Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of operations.
* **Team Management:** 
 Manage and develop a high-performing team, including training, performance management, and career development.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Partner with underwriting, claims, IT, compliance, and sales teams to ensure seamless service delivery and operational alignment.
* **Technology & Automation:** 
 Leverage technology and automation tools to streamline workflows and reduce manual tasks.
* **Compliance & Risk Management:** 
 Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, internal controls, and company policies.
* **Reporting & Analytics:** 
 Monitor KPIs, service levels, and operational metrics to drive data-informed decisions and continuous improvement.
* **Customer Experience:** 
 Champion a customer-first mindset, ensuring high service standards for brokers, agents, and policyholders.

**Competencies & Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of experience in insurance operations
* Proven leadership experience managing teams and driving operational excellence
* Strong knowledge of insurance products, systems, and regulatory environment
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Change management and process improvement expertise

**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Insurance, or related field preferred
* Experience with insurance platforms (e.g. Applied Epic)
 

**Disclaimer:**

While this job description is intended to be an accurate reflection of the job requirements, management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties from particular jobs and to assign other duties as necessary.

**Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO):**

FRP provides equal employment opportunity to qualified persons regardless of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or any other classifications protected by law.

**Benefits:**

FRP offers a comprehensive range of health-related benefit options including medical, vision, and dental. We offer a 401(k) with company match, company paid life insurance, STD, LTD and a generous PTO policy starting at 18 days per year plus 10 paid holidays & 2 floating holidays!

new_roles.title: Director-Quality Management - Acute
new_roles.description:
Director-Quality Management - Acute | Highland Hospital | Charleston, West Virginia

**About the Job:**

PURPOSE STATEMENT: 
 
The Director of Quality, Risk & Compliance leads and coordinates quality and performance improvement, regulatory compliance, and patient safety efforts within the healthcare facility. This role ensures that all programs operate within local, state, federal, and accreditation standards, while driving a culture of continuous improvement, clinical excellence, and risk reduction.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Provides oversight of all facility programs, including inpatient and outpatient services, ensuring alignment with quality, risk management, patient safety, and regulatory standards.
* Leads facility-wide quality, risk, and patient safety strategy and improvement efforts.
* Directs the Quality Assurance/Performance Improvement (QAPI) program, including development, implementation, and evaluation; monitors KPIs and ensures governance of data-driven improvement efforts.
* Drives organization-wide performance improvement initiatives through data analysis and system-level process enhancements to improve outcomes.
* Oversees incident reporting, investigations, and risk analyses (RCA/Event Analysis), ensuring timely resolution and prevention of recurrence.
* Maintains compliance with all local, state, federal (CMS), and accreditation standards (TJC), ensures ongoing survey readiness, and serves as the primary liaison during regulatory and accreditation surveys, audits, and required reporting activities.
* Partners with the Legal, Compliance, and Risk Department on high-risk events, complaints/allegations, investigations, and corrective action planning.
* Supports the development, review, and implementation of facility policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and consistent adherence across departments.
* Collaborates with department leaders and Human Resources to support staff accountability and ensure adherence to facility policies and procedures.
* Provides staff training and mentoring to support competency, accountability, and adherence to quality, risk, and safety standards, while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and patient safety.
* Conducts leadership rounding, medical record reviews, and monitoring of environment of care, safety, and documentation standards.
* Prepares and maintains required reports and documentation; participates in committees, meetings, audits, and organizational initiatives.
* Supervises Patient Advocate/Coordinator roles, when applicable, through hiring, orienting, performance assessment and management, motivating, training, scheduling, and coaching to meet department and facility goals. Supports resolution of patient concerns and patient rights processes.
* Serves as Patient Safety and Compliance Officer, providing oversight of patient safety, risk management, and event reporting processes within organizational governance structures.
* Serves as Patient Safety and Compliance Officer, providing oversight of client safety, risk management, and event reporting processes within organizational governance structures.
* May serve as Privacy/Security Officer, providing direction and oversight of activities related to compliance with applicable Federal and State law and regulations governing the privacy and security of health information.
* May serve as Chief Healthcare Disparities Officer, leading efforts to identify, analyze, and reduce disparities in care for the populations served.
* May be required to provide onsite coverage for other programs when needed, develops, and executes new programs according to market needs and may provide training, case consultation and Administrator On Call coverage during and after program hours as needed.

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE/SKILL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s degree with a clinical, nursing or business emphasis required. Master’s degree in Human Services preferred.
* Three years’ experience in quality, patient safety, regulatory compliance, risk management, survey management, behavioral health, substance use disorder treatment, or related experience required.
* Knowledge and understanding of state/federal regulations, Joint Commission and/or CARF Accreditation.

**LICENSES/DESIGNATIONS/CERTIFICATIONS:**

* CPHQ Preferred
* Professional clinical license issued by the appropriate licensing body as required by the state.
* CPR and de-escalation and restraint certification required (training available upon hire and offered by facility).
* First aid may be required based on state or facility

**WORK LOCATION:**

This position is onsite at the facility and is not a remote position.

**SUPERVISORY REQUIREMENTS:**

Two years’ supervisory/management experience in behavioral health preferred.

Why Highland Hospital?Highland Hospital offers a comprehensive benefit plan and a competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications. Qualified candidates should apply by submitting a resume. Highland Hospital is an EOE.

Veterans and military spouses are highly encouraged to apply. Summit BHC is dedicated to serving Veterans with specialized programming at our treatment centers across the country. We recognize and value the unique strengths of the military community in supporting our mission to serve those who have served.

new_roles.title: Director Quality & Compliance
new_roles.description:
**Job Description:**

**Who We Are:**

At Cart.com, we're **defining the future of commerce.**

Founded to solve the growing complexity of modern commerce, Cart.com helps businesses simplify how they sell, fulfill, and deliver products to their customers. We bring together technology, services, and logistics infrastructure into one connected platform, making it easier for organizations to grow, operate efficiently, and navigate an increasingly fragmented commerce landscape.

We work with brands, retailers, manufacturers, and public sector organizations to support every stage of the customer journey, from ecommerce and order management to fulfillment, distribution, and delivery. By combining software, expertise, and a nationwide logistics network into a unified solution, we help our customers move faster, operate smarter, and scale with confidence.

But what truly sets Cart.com apart is our people. We're builders, problem-solvers, and innovators who thrive on turning big challenges into meaningful outcomes for our customers. Every day, we're helping shape the future of commerce while creating opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact.

If you're energized by solving complex problems, collaborating with talented teammates, and helping build what's next, we'd love to hear from you.

**Cart.com Milestones**

* Founded in 2020 with a vision to build the first truly unified commerce platform.
* Achieved unicorn status with a valuation exceeding $1 billion.
* Raised more than $475 million to support continued growth and innovation
* Expanded a nationwide commerce and logistics network that helps organizations scale, fulfill, and grow across channels.
* Recognized by Inc.'s Power Partner Awards for helping businesses grow and scale.
* Recognized as an award-winning employer for four consecutive years, reflecting our commitment to building an environment where talented people can grow, innovate, and make an impact.

**Our values:** Cart.com is building a company that is committed to living out these 6 core values:

* **Be brand obsessed:** Our lives are shaped by the brands we interact with daily. We obsess over the brands we serve, and about the things they care about.
* **Think beyond the box:** “We’ve always done it that way” is not a phrase uttered often at our office. We create creative solutions to complex problems.

* **Don’t give up:** We learn from our challenges and see them for what they are; great building blocks to an amazing brand story.
* **Speak up:** We communicate clearly and directly because we care deeply. Communication is the bedrock of our community.
* **Work together:** We’ve built a team that prides itself on diversity of thought and background. Collaboration is better with contrast.
* **Remember to be human:** We work hard, but we leave room for the people, places and things that we love

**AI is part of how we work. It's not doing the hiring.** 
 
We'll use AI in parts of our process and we think you should feel free to use it too — for research, prep, whatever helps. But our interviews exist to meet *you*, not your best AI-assisted draft. Real people make every call here. Any questions about how this works, just ask.

**Remote:**

This position is fully remote and open to candidates in AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, DE, FL, GA, HI, IL, IN, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MO, MS, NC, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA. The salary range for this role is $175,000-200,000 annually. Actual compensation may vary based on geographic location, experience and qualifications. This role is eligible for bonus, equity and benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off. Applications accepted through 1-31-2027. We comply with all applicable pay transparency laws in the states where we operate.

**The Role:**

The Director, Quality and Compliance leads the quality function for Cart.com’s federal pharmaceutical distribution business across four sites. This leader will standardize and strengthen an established quality program, develop site quality leaders, ensure consistent application of procedures, and serve as the primary quality point of contact for client reporting, audits and product-quality events.

This is approximately a 70% strategic leadership and 30% hands-on role. The Director will not build the program from the ground up, but will assess the current-state program, make targeted improvements, and ensure teams consistently execute against client, regulatory and network requirements. The role is remote with approximately 30% travel.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead and develop site quality leaders across Maryland, Goodyear, Temecula and Memphis, establishing clear accountability, delegation and follow-through.
* Standardize quality procedures and expectations across the network while refining the existing quality management system and closing identified gaps.
* Ensure sites remain prepared for client and regulatory audits; support audit planning, host or coordinate inspections, and oversee timely responses and corrective actions.
* Serve as the primary quality point of contact for pharmaceutical product excursions and related client reporting, ensuring submissions are accurate, complete and timely.
* Oversee quality processes supporting receiving, quarantine, release, disposition, returns, destruction, recalls, deviations, corrective and preventive actions, change control, training, complaints and document control.
* Guide quality decisions for controlled-temperature pharmaceutical products, including refrigerated, frozen and ultra-cold storage and distribution.
* Partner with site Operations leaders and Cart.com’s Compliance team to implement operational changes required to meet quality standards and client expectations.
* Use quality metrics, audit findings, client feedback and site observations to identify risk, prioritize improvements and report progress to senior leadership.
* Travel to sites for audit preparation, team development, quality reviews and issue resolution.

**Who You Are:**

 

* You are a strategic, hands-on quality leader who can set direction while stepping into audits, excursions and site-readiness work when needed.
* You lead through others, delegate clearly, establish checkpoints and hold site quality leaders accountable for follow-through.
* You put the client’s requirements first, ask the right questions and respond with accurate, timely information.
* You communicate with credibility and composure across clients, regulators, Operations, Compliance and senior leadership.
* You are highly organized and disciplined, ensuring commitments, documentation and escalations do not get lost.
* You build strong cross-functional partnerships and can influence operational changes without creating a separate quality silo.
* You adapt to changing federal-client requirements while maintaining consistent quality standards and sound judgment.
* You develop people, address performance gaps directly and create a culture of ownership across a distributed team.

**What You’ve Done:**

 

* 7+ years of progressive pharmaceutical quality experience, including work in a current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) environment.
* 5+ years of people-leadership experience with demonstrated success delegating, developing leaders and holding teams accountable. Direct leadership of quality teams is preferred.
* Worked in pharmaceutical distribution, wholesale, logistics or third-party logistics (3PL). Manufacturing experience alone is not sufficient without meaningful distribution-quality exposure.
* Applied cGMP, Good Distribution Practice (GDP), controlled-document and standard operating procedure requirements in a regulated pharmaceutical environment.
* Prepared for or led audits involving the U.S. Food and Drug Administration or comparable regulators, including managing responses and follow-up actions.
* Supported pharmaceutical product release, disposition, holds, recalls or temperature-excursion decisions in a regulated distribution setting.
* Written, revised or implemented quality procedures and documentation, then ensured consistent execution across teams or sites.
* Led a distributed or multi-site team and built accountability through site leaders rather than personally owning every task.
* Managed a significant client, product-quality or regulatory issue requiring coordination across Quality, Operations and Compliance.
* Earned a bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, biology, chemistry or a related field, or bring an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
* Ability to travel up to 30%.

**Nice to Haves:**

 

* Background supporting federal health programs or agencies such as HHS, DLA, ASPR, BARDA, DoD or VA.
* Experience with pharmaceutical 3PLs, wholesalers, state licensing or NABP accreditation.
* Hands-on experience with vaccines or other cold-chain and ultra-cold pharmaceutical products.

new_roles.title: Regional Director Operations-RD
new_roles.description:
The Regional Director of Operations is responsible for providing operational leadership, client partnership support, and strategic oversight for multiple senior living dining and hospitality accounts within an assigned region. This position partners closely with community leadership teams, culinary operations, resident experience teams, and corporate leadership to ensure operational excellence, financial performance, hospitality culture, regulatory compliance, and elevated resident satisfaction across all assigned communities.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is an exempt salaried position, with expected hours to include: days, evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Essential Functions and Duties

Operational Leadership

* Provide leadership and operational oversight for multiple senior living dining and hospitality accounts
* Support and mentor Directors of Dining Services, Executive Chefs, Resident Experience leaders, and community management teams
* Ensure operational consistency, hospitality standards, and service excellence throughout all assigned communities
* Conduct regular operational visits, audits, and performance reviews

Client & Resident Relationships

* Build and maintain strong relationships with client leadership teams, residents, families, and operational partners
* Ensure resident satisfaction initiatives and hospitality-focused service culture remain a top operational priority
* Participate in client meetings, operational reviews, and strategic planning discussions
* Address operational concerns and support service recovery initiatives when needed

Financial Management

* Manage regional financial performance including:

* labor management,
* food cost controls,
* budgeting,
* forecasting,
* and overall account profitability

* Analyze financial reports and operational metrics to identify opportunities for improvement
* Support implementation of operational efficiencies and cost-control initiatives

Culinary & Hospitality Excellence

* Support culinary innovation, menu development, dining presentation, and hospitality-driven service initiatives
* Ensure dining environments reflect company hospitality standards and resident experience expectations
* Promote elevated dining experiences throughout all communities

Associate Leadership & Development

* Recruit, coach, mentor, and develop operational leadership teams
* Support associate engagement, retention, succession planning, and performance management initiatives
* Foster a positive, professional, and accountability-driven culture throughout the region
* Assist with onboarding and transition support for new business and leadership changes

Compliance & Quality Assurance

* Ensure compliance with all federal, state, local, and company regulations and standards
* Support sanitation, food safety, healthcare compliance, and regulatory audit readiness
* Conduct operational assessments and quality assurance reviews
* Ensure corrective action plans are implemented and maintained when necessary

Travel

This role will be 80-100% travel. Travel will be by car and/or plane and will include overnight travel.

General Responsibility as Required for Position

The Regional Director of Operations serves as the primary operational leader supporting community-level Directors, Executive Chefs, and management teams while helping drive consistency, service excellence, associate engagement, and overall client satisfaction throughout the region. This role requires strong leadership presence, hospitality mindse, financial acumen, and the ability to build strong operational partnerships within senior living environments

AAP/EEO Statement

Forefront will not discriminate based on race, color, sex, height, weight, disability, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, military service, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or any other protected class in its hiring practices, conditions for transfer or promotion, policies, discipline, discharge, terms, conditions or benefits of employment.

Other Duties as assigned

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Job duties, tasks, responsibilities, and activities may change from time to time.

Requirements:

Education/Experience/Training

* Bachelor’s degree preferred in Hospitality Management, Culinary Management, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or related field
* 5+ years of progressive multi-site operational leadership experience
* Senior living, healthcare dining, hospitality, or foodservice management experience strongly preferred
* Strong financial management and operational analysis experience
* Experience leading large operational teams across multiple locations
* Excellent leadership, communication, and relationship management skills
* Strong problem-solving and organizational abilities
* Ability to travel extensively throughout assigned region

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Senior living dining and hospitality experience
* Multi-unit healthcare or hospitality operational leadership experience
* Culinary operations and resident experience knowledge
* Experience with client relationship management and contract dining operations
* ServSafe Certification preferred

new_roles.title: Director of Production
new_roles.description:
MHI Ship Repair & Services is a major marine repair and conversion contractor serving the U.S. Navy, Military Sealift Command, Maritime Administration and Commercial ship owners and operators worldwide. Our shipyard is conveniently located in the Mid-Atlantic region at the port of Hampton Roads, Norfolk Virginia.

**JOB SUMMARY:** Manages the operations of all production trades to include Facilities and Gas Free. Responsible for ensuring that all projects are manned with competent, properly trained and certified personnel, and the work efforts are coordinated and executed in a cost-effective manner, safely, and on time. Provides leadership and guidance to Shop Superintendants and oversees the maintenance and improvement of all shop equipment and development of shop procedures.

**SUPERVISES:** All Shop Superintendents

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Primary oversight of all production departments to include Facilities and Gas Free. Responsible for making strategic and tactical decisions related to certain aspects of MHI's production business to include operation non-Program work
* Responsible for ensuring that all projects are manned with competent, properly trained and certified personnel, and that work efforts are prioritized, coordinated and efforts integrated between departments and executed safely, in a cost-effective manner and on time.
* Ensures performance is within the guidelines of the contracts, delivery orders are received and that all contractual requirements are within the scope of work for the specific market and are met for U.S. Navy, Government, private shipyard, and commercial projects.
* Holds daily production meetings with all trades and Project Managers. Communicate with all department heads to ensure that any manning, scheduling, tooling, and material issues are identified and resolved.
* Attend all SRA Production Meetings.
* Walks through all in plant vessels daily verifying all work in progress and identifying and resolving any issues as they arise.
* Provides leadership and guidance to Shop Superintendants and oversees the maintenance and improvement of all shop equipment and development of shop procedures.
* Reviews and proofreads specs.

**ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Estimating as requested.
* May on occasion be required to manage a project.
* Performs other related duties as assigned by supervisor.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* College education and 15 years progressive experience in the maritime industry. (Apprenticeship and practical experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.) Prior management experience a must.
* Ability to estimate.
* Basic knowledge of all skilled trades, and ability to manage effectively.
* Ability to communicate effectively as a leader.

MHI Ship Repair & Services offers competitive wages and an excellent benefit package.

Affirmative Action/EOE Employer of protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

new_roles.title: Director Engineering Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Job ID: 116026**

 

The Leonardo DRS Naval Electronics business provides leading naval computing infrastructure, network and data distribution and middleware enterprise services, as well as world-class manufacturing and support capabilities.

**Business Unit**: Naval Electronics
 
**Location**: Eagan, MN
 
**Career Functional Area**: Engineering
 
**Telework Type**: Hybrid
 
**Travel Expectation**: 30%
 
**Schedule**: 9/80

**Job Summary**
---------------

Responsible for establishing and continuously improving the processes, tools, and data-management practices that enable disciplined, compliant, and efficient engineering execution across all programs. Own engineering configuration-management standards, processes and execution releasing the E BOM. Monitor the quality of engineering deliverables identifying opportunities of improvement.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Engineering Process Ownership and Excellence**

* Define, deploy, maintain, and continuously improve standardized engineering processes, procedures, work instructions, templates
* Ensure engineering processes are practical for program execution while meeting applicable customer, contractual, quality, regulatory, cybersecurity, and internal requirements.
* Establish process ownership, approval authorities, compliance expectations, training requirements, and periodic process-review cycles.
* Lead process maturity assessments, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and implement corrective and preventive improvements.

**Engineering Tools and Digital Strategy**

* Define the engineering tools strategy, roadmap, governance model, and deployment plans in partnership with Engineering, IT, Quality, Supply Chain, and program teams.
* Lead deployment, adoption, administration requirements, user support models, and continuous improvement of engineering tools, including product lifecycle management, requirements management, analysis, collaboration, and configuration-management tools.
* Ensure tools, workflows, data structures, and integrations support disciplined engineering execution, traceability, release control, and reliable engineering data.
* Capture user and program needs; prioritize enhancements, integrations, and new capabilities based on business value, risk reduction, compliance, and program demand.

**Engineering Configuration Management**

* Own the engineering configuration-management process, standards, governance, and associated tool workflows.
* Establish common rules for engineering baselines, configuration identification, revision control, change management, release authorization, and configuration-status accounting.
* Ensure configuration-management processes support full traceability between requirements, drawings, parts, assemblies, bills of material, changes, verification evidence, and released product definition.
* Define the governance framework for configuration control boards and ensure appropriate technical, quality, programmatic, manufacturing, supply-chain, and customer inputs are incorporated where required.

**Job Responsibilities (Cont.)**
--------------------------------

**Program Configuration-Management Support**

* Provide configuration-management process leadership and tailored support to programs from proposal through product support.
* Support development, review, and maintenance of program Configuration Management Plans and related configuration-management deliverables.
* Establish program-specific configuration baselines, release schedules, change-control workflows, approval matrices, and reporting appropriate to contractual and product requirements.
* Support programs in resolving configuration-management issues, ensuring timely decisions and minimizing release, production, and customer-impact risk.

**Product-Definition Data Integrity**

* Govern the processes for drawing-number creation, part-number assignment, nomenclature, document classification, and engineering-data release.
* Ensure new drawing and part numbers are created, controlled, and uniquely identified in accordance with approved standards and system rules.
* Establish validation controls for engineering drawings, parts, assemblies, and engineering bills of material (EBOMs), including consistency, completeness, revision alignment, and traceability.
* Monitor the integrity of released product-definition data and drive resolution of discrepancies that could affect procurement, manufacturing, verification, sustainment, or customer deliverables.

**Engineering Deliverable Quality and Performance Monitoring**

* Define the quality criteria, review expectations, and performance measures for engineering deliverables.
* Monitor the quality, completeness, timeliness, and first-pass acceptance of engineering outputs, including requirements artifacts, drawings, specifications, analysis reports, test documentation, change packages, and released product data.
* Analyze defects, rework, late changes, release escapes, configuration discrepancies, and recurring nonconformities to identify systemic causes and improvement opportunities.
* Provide leadership with regular visibility into engineering-process performance, deliverable quality trends, compliance risks, and recommended corrective actions.

**Continuous Improvement and Assurance**

* Lead improvement initiatives that strengthen engineering execution, reduce rework, improve data quality, and increase delivery predictability.
* Develop and recommend improvement actions based on performance data, audit findings, lessons learned, user feedback, program needs, and changes in business or customer requirements.
* Verify the effectiveness of implemented improvements and maintain an actionable backlog of process, tool, and data-governance enhancements.
* Support internal and external audits by maintaining objective evidence of process compliance, configuration control, tool governance, and engineering-data integrity.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; advanced degree or relevant professional certification preferred
* 10+ years of progressive experience in engineering, engineering operations, configuration management, PLM, quality, or systems engineering within a complex and regulated product environment.
* 5+ years in a leadership role responsible for engineering processes, tools, configuration management, quality, or operational excellence.
* Experience developing and deploying engineering processes, governance controls, workflows, and performance measures.
* Experience leading implementation and improvement of engineering tools, including PLM, requirements-management, design-data management, and configuration-management systems.
* Practical experience with Configuration Management Plans, engineering change control, drawing and part-number management, release control, and EBOM validation.
* Proven record of improving engineering deliverable quality, data integrity, process compliance, and operational efficiency

**Additional Qualifications**
-----------------------------

* Strong knowledge of engineering product-development processes, configuration management, product-data control, and engineering release practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders in a matrix organization.
* Strong analytical, communication, and continuous-improvement skills

**U.S. Citizenship required. This position requires an active DOD security clearance or the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment.**

Our benefits package includes comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision), employer matching 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off including vacation, holidays, and sick leave (including ant state-mandated paid sick leave), parental leave benefits, tuition reimbursement, professional development support, and life and disability insurance coverage.*

 

*Taking care of our people is a top priority at Leonardo DRS. We are proud to offer competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a company contribution to a health savings account, telemedicine, life and disability insurance, legal insurance, and a 401(k) savings plan. We champion wellness programs that focus on physical, emotional, and financial well-being. new_roles.title: Managing Director, Academic Program Operations
new_roles.description:
**About Achievement First**

Achievement First (AF) is a non-profit 501(c)(3) organization that currently supports 41 public charter schools in New York, Connecticut, and Rhode Island. Consistently rated as one of the top charter school networks in the country for almost 25 years, AF is committed to continuous improvement, programmatic evolution for enhanced student outcomes, and sustainable growth. The majority of AF students are Black and Latinx children from low-income families who will be the first in their families to graduate from college. AF currently employs more than 2,200 staff — 64% of whom identify as Black, Indigenous, and People of Color — who collectively educate nearly 15,000 students in Brooklyn and Queens, NY; New Haven, Bridgeport, and Hartford, CT; and Providence, RI.

The mission of Achievement First is to deliver on the promise of equal educational opportunity for all of America's children. AF knows that every child—regardless of race, zip code, or economic status—deserves access to great schools. At AF, students realize their potential and develop the skills they need to graduate from high school, succeed in college, thrive in a competitive world, and serve as the next generation of leaders in their communities. At AF, students and staff embark on a shared journey to fulfill their incredible potential.

 

*We are looking for a* Managing Director of Academic Program Operations *to join our Academic Strategy & Execution team.*

**Your Impact**

The Managing Director of Academic Program Operations will serve as a senior strategic partner and operations expert working with the Academic Program Team to deliver on the implementation of Achievement First's school model & instructional priorities. This role is ideal for someone who has a deep knowledge of schools both as instructional institutions but also the intersection with funding, finance, operations, and talent practices. The Managing Director of of Academic Program Operations will partner with the Deputy Chief of Academic Strategy & Execution and other senior program leaders to deliver on a cohesive & coherent experience of our school model and support the change management involved in refining our model to align to our aims for our Achievement First graduates anchored in knowledge of self & community, college, career, & life readiness, and purpose & leadership. The Managing Director of Academic Program Operations does not need to be the content expert in any given domain, but should be a fast learner able to bring people together to solve challenges & inspire change, and be able to communicate across a variety of stakeholders including school leaders & school based staff, as well as leaders of functional teams in the organization.

*Reporting directly to the Deputy Chief of Academic Strategy & Execution you will be responsible for:*

* Managing the implementation of our current school design and instructional priorities
* + Run the project-to-operations transition gate for school design changes. Accept finished projects into standing ownership only once standard work, calendars, budget, reporting, and escalation paths are in place.
 + Set service levels for each recurring function and run an annual improvement cycle that names what to automate, transition, or outsource.
 + Manage vendor and contract relationships for recurring academic infrastructure, including renewals and performance against agreed terms.
 + Lead the Academic Operations portion of the work and talent review: inventory current work, classify it as keep, stop, or transfer, and match people to defined roles.
 + Oversee the annual planning, operations actions and execution needed across curriculum, assessment, professional learning operations, school budget development, calendar and the operations behind our instructional priorities needed to deliver our current model and priorities with excellence
 + Partner with Deputy Chiefs of School Design, and senior Academic Program leads to operationalizing our current design, recommend operational decisions for the following year and execute once decided around current policies and strategies.
 + Organize the Academic Operations team around needed capabilities and organizational impact
 + Manage Academic Operations team budget and set up monitoring systems to ensure accurate monthly forecasting each month
 + Manage a team of 4-6 direct reports who support implementation, decision making and execution of our current model.

* Drive excellence and improvement across all Academic Program infrastructure and operations
* + Curriculum and materials: Own purchasing, publication, distribution, and materials planning for network curriculum, so every classroom has what it needs before the first day of school.
 + Assessment: Run administration of state, College Board, and internal assessments, including testing windows, platforms, compliance, audits, and score reporting. Maintain the network assessment calendar. Identify which steps can be automated or outsourced to free up team capacity.
 + Professional learning: Oversee the operations behind summer and school year PD. This covers calendars, venues, registration, materials, logistics, and completion tracking. Partner with the content owners who design each training.

* Define distinct recurring academic operating functions from school management related services
* + Publish and maintain a scope map for Academic Operations and School Management Services that names what each team owns and partners on, with RAPID roles for shared decisions.
 + Own the network-level version of recurring infrastructure: academic calendar, assessment windows, materials timelines, and PD calendars.
 + Build one intake path for school and regional requests.
 + Hold the regional support work currently carried by current team until the School Management Services defined then hand it off with documented standard work.
 + Review the boundary twice a year. Track misrouted or duplicated work and move it to its right home before either team turns into a catch-all.

* Strategic Leadership, Annual Planning and Cross-Functional Operations Management (yearly & ad-hoc)
* + Set clear standards of excellence for each function, performance manage, and build specialized expertise on the team.
 + In partnership with senior project managers, oversee and manage a cohesive approach to planning for the upcoming school year each year. Deliverables include school regional calendars, comprehensive network policies/consistent practices for schools and serving as a gatekeeper on recurring academic tasks and events added to the school calendar.
 + Serve as a key thought partner to senior leaders to ensure efficiency, effectiveness and optimal use of all available resources and personnel across program teams.
 + Strategize with senior leaders on academic policy development and problem resolution; ensure implementation plans are effectively communicated and managed.

Additionally, this role will support the work of the team with ad hoc needs, including building operational documents, peer review of detailed resources, data entry, etc.

**Candidate Profile**

All candidates for this position will have a bachelor's degree and 2+ years of experience managing managers and leading complex, recurring operations across multiple stakeholders. An ideal candidate will have 2+ years of successful teaching experience, and/or a background in school operations or school leadership. There is a preference for candidates based in the regions where our schools are located (New York, Connecticut, and Rhode Island). The successful candidate must commit to being on-site in New York, Connecticut, and/or Rhode Island during July and August.

*In addition, the following characteristics are required to be successful on this team:*

* Track record of managing managers: setting clear standards of excellence, giving direct and timely feedback, and building specialized expertise on a team
* Judges success by results for schools. Willing to stop, automate, or outsource work that isn't producing them
* Owns problems through to resolution, works with peers before escalating, and brings escalations with options and a recommendation attached
* Acts on what the work needs without waiting to be asked, and brings a clear point of view when a decision sits above the role
* Experience building and running recurring operations at scale, including standard work, service levels, annual planning calendars, and continuous improvement
* Experience managing a department budget with accurate monthly forecasting, plus vendor and contract management
* Experience running large, multi-site training events and logistics
* Comfort with assessment and data platforms, and the ability to turn operational data into clear reporting
* Experience leading a team through organizational change, including role changes and new ways of working
* Confident in interacting with and influencing individuals at all levels, including state departments of education and external partners
* Exceptional eye for detail, follow-up, and organization
* Excellent verbal and written communication, with the ability to explain complex ideas simply
* Belief in the Achievement First mission and educational model

**Travel Expectations**

This is a hybrid role. The expectation is that the person in the role would be able to come into the Network Support office (NYC, CT, or RI) at least three times a week. There may be additional travel to regions outside of your own on a monthly basis.

**Compensation** 
Achievement First sets salaries through a lens of equity, based on the skills, education, and experience the role requires. The salary range for this position is $150,331 to $183,002. We place new hires within this range based on their years of experience in a comparable position, using the same criteria for every candidate. Most new hires should expect an offer at or below the midpoint of the range ($166,667). Additionally, Achievement First offers all regular, full-time employees a comprehensive benefits package that includes paid time off, medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, a 403(b) retirement plan with match, and paid Family Leave.

*Achievement First is an equal opportunity employer and an organization that values diversity. People from all diverse backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply. Spanish language proficiency is a plus. You can learn more about diversity at Achievement First here:* *http://achievementfirst.org/about-us/diversity/*

new_roles.title: Director Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Build Your Career with Ashley Furniture- Where Innovation Meets Comfort**

**Who We Are:**

At Ashley, inspiring the love of home is at the heart of everything we do. As the world’s largest manufacturer of home furnishings, we’re more than a business — we’re a family driven by innovation, competitiveness, and an unwavering commitment to excellence. We persevere through challenges, push beyond the status quo, and constantly seek better ways to deliver an exceptional customer experience. Our solutions-first mindset and dedication to growth are why Ashley remains #1 in our industry.

If you’re ready to grow, you’ve come to the right place. With a true “Growth Mindset,” Ashley Furniture invests in developing future leaders and helps every team member learn from the best in the business.

 

**If you are a current Ashley employee**: Please login to your UKG account and apply using the internal job board.

 

**Summary:**

The Ashley Home Delivery (AHD) Operational Excellence Director provides centralized leadership for operational planning, routing, process development, project execution, vendor governance, performance management, and organizational coordination across Ashley Home Delivery. This role translates strategy into repeatable operating standards, disciplined execution, measurable performance, and scalable support.

The Director partners with field leadership and cross-functional teams to improve customer experience, delivery performance, carrier accountability, cost effectiveness, and launch readiness, enabling Regional Directors and market leaders to remain focused on field execution.

**Responsibilities:**

**Operational Planning & Routing**

* Lead the centralized routing organization, establishing operating rhythms, service standards, workload allocation, escalation paths, and accountability.
* Own delivery forecasting, capacity planning, route-planning governance, and resource alignment across AHD markets.
* Develop, document, deploy, and audit routing standards that support safe, efficient, reliable, and customer-focused delivery execution.
* Partner with field leaders to identify capacity constraints, route-quality issues, and execution risks, coordinating corrective actions as needed.

**Operational Excellence**

* Lead the development, maintenance, communication, and adoption of standard operating procedures across Ashley Home Delivery.
* Design and continuously improve end-to-end processes for stand-up, load-out, route monitoring, check-in, returns, recovery, beginning-of-day controls, and end-of-day controls.
* Develop validation, compliance, and audit tools to ensure operating standards are understood, adopted, and sustained.
* Drive continuous improvement through data analysis, root-cause analysis, structured problem-solving, and field feedback.
* Establish governance and documentation processes that preserve institutional knowledge and keep operating standards current.

**3PL & Vendor Management**

* Lead carrier sourcing, due diligence, onboarding, implementation, and performance governance in partnership with Procurement, Legal, Finance, Risk, and AHD leadership.
* Establish consistent business reviews, escalation processes, relationship-management routines, and service expectations for delivery partners.
* Provide leadership for the AHD Claims team and governance of claims administration, disputes, documentation, approval controls, and timely resolution.
* Oversee invoice validation and payment-administration processes, including controls that support accuracy, transparency, and accountability.
* Support contract improvements and ensure approved terms, service levels, and operating requirements are effectively implemented.

**Performance Management**

* Develop and maintain national AHD KPI definitions, reporting standards, scorecards, forecasts, and performance dashboards.
* Establish management routines connecting daily operating controls, weekly business reviews, action plans, and executive-level visibility.
* Analyze performance trends and operational gaps, identify root causes, establish accountable owners, and track corrective actions through resolution.
* Provide decision-ready reporting on customer experience, delivery reliability, productivity, capacity, cost, claims, and carrier performance.

**Strategic Projects & Launch Execution**

* Lead program and project management for AHD market launches, conversions, expansions, and national operational initiatives.
* Establish launch-readiness plans covering schedules, staffing, training, travel, uniforms, fleet, equipment, routing, carrier readiness, communications, and operating controls.
* Coordinate cross-functional implementation activities, manage dependencies and risks, and maintain clear milestones, decisions, ownership, and status reporting.
* Drive post-launch adoption and ensure new processes, tools, contracts, and standards become embedded in routine operations.

**People & Organizational Leadership**

* Lead, develop, and deploy assigned AHD support resources against the highest-priority operational and strategic needs.
* Establish clear roles, decision rights, service expectations, workload priorities, and performance standards for centralized support functions.
* Build a high-accountability, service-oriented culture that partners effectively with Regional Directors, site leaders, carriers, and cross-functional teams.
* Coach and develop team members through ongoing feedback, development planning, and recommendations regarding staffing, selection, recognition, and performance actions in accordance with company policy.

**Qualifications:**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in operations, transportation, logistics, supply chain, home delivery, final mile, or a related field.
* 5+ years of leadership experience with responsibility for teams, operational programs, or multi-site/multi-market operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading operational excellence, process improvement, performance management, and large-scale implementation initiatives.
* Experience managing third-party carriers, 3PL providers, vendors, or outsourced delivery operations.
* Experience developing and managing KPIs, scorecards, operating reviews, and performance improvement plans.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations, Service Delivery
new_roles.description:
**About LawnStarter**

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, spanning three brands: LawnStarter, Lawn Love, and Home Gnome. We've cleared $750M in bookings and turned a profit three years running. Founded in Austin in 2013, we're a team of about 180 that scales past 500 employees during peak season. The marketplace itself is easy to describe and hard to run well: a customer requests a service, we price the job and match it to an eligible Pro, the Pro claims and completes the work, and we process payment and take a commission.

We're entering the most ambitious stretch in the company's history as we build new verticals, new software products, and the groundwork to become a multi-billion-dollar company.

One of our company values is AI or Extinction: every task, AI-first. No exceptions, no excuses. Top 1% or we're already a fossil. This role is hired against that bar.

**The Role**

This is a biz ops generalist role, built for someone who wants to work across many parts of the business instead of owning one narrow lane. You'll start as an individual contributor with no direct reports, in a new seat reporting directly to the COO. Your first owned area will be building Service Delivery into a working operational function. This will entail adding structure, visibility and process to the way we ensure as many customer jobs as possible are completed successfully and on time by LawnStarter Pros, in lawn care and other services we offer now and over time.

New projects will show up unscoped over time. That's by design. As LawnStarter enters new verticals and grows toward a multi-billion-dollar future, big problems will keep surfacing with no obvious owner, and you'll be one of the people the COO trusts to run them down.

**What makes this role different:**

* You work on some of the biggest company-wide projects, cutting across teams and functional areas.
* You'll be a top builder in Brain, LawnStarter's internal AI toolkit built on Claude Code that already powers everything we do across the company: metric queries, document drafting, bug triage, and more. We expect you to approach your work in an AI-first fashion, leveraging Brain to build new systems and processes that will push the limits of how fast AI can accelerate business results. Every project you run is built AI-first: the analysis, the tooling, the process automation, the monitoring. You build it yourself instead of waiting on an analyst or engineer.
* You own outcomes end to end, from recommendation through execution. Strategy without follow-through doesn't count here.

**What You'll Own**

* **Service Delivery, from the ground up.** Despite LawnStarter's considerable scale and reach, Service Delivery doesn't exist yet as a dedicated function. You'll help define the standards we should meet for job completion rates and speed, measure whether we hit them, and design processes, incentives and real-time interventions that get tested with Pros and customers in the field to lift performance. Scope covers every vertical and every delivery model, from today's 1099 Pros to potential W-2 crews under future evaluation.
* **Raising customer & Pro retention rates.** When we deliver service with excellence, Pros and customers alike stay with us longer. Working tightly with peers across Product, Data and Support, you'll identify new opportunities for us to boost retention and LTV and play a key role in driving resulting initiatives cross-functionally.
* **Whatever comes next.** New projects will land on your plate as the company grows into new verticals and builds new software products. You'll take them from "we should look into this" to building and then running systems with structure, KPIs and owners.

**Problems to Solve**

**Build a Service Delivery function that doesn't exist yet.** Right now, no one formally owns whether LawnStarter delivers the service it promises. You'll define the standard for what a Pro should deliver, then build the agents and pipelines that measure adherence to it and run the tests that change behaviors and outcomes in the field.

**Move metrics.** Leverage systems thinking and AI expertise to drive business results that sit across various functional teams. That means untangling handoffs where several teams touch a problem or goal and no one team owns the outcome.

**Take unscoped problems from ideas to fully-running and automated systems.** Some of the most important work here hasn't been named yet. At some point, someone will raise a fuzzy, unframed problem and say it needs attention. Your job is to take that starting point and build whatever tooling or process it needs, at record speed, and hand back something that runs, with a clear owner and quantitative targets attached.

**What Success Looks Like (Year 1)**

* Service Delivery is a working function with a defined (and elevated) service standard, a way to measure adherence to it, clear SOPs, and an intervention and incentive playbook that's been tested and proven to lift results.
* At least one project nobody had scoped a year earlier has gone from "we should look into this" to a heavily-automated, running system with a named owner and tracked KPIs.
* Tools you built with AI are in daily use by people other than you, and the way you work has raised the bar for how the company uses AI.
* The COO can hand you a gray-area problem with no playbook and trust that what comes back is data, a recommendation, and a plan to execute it.

 
**Requirements**

**Who You Are**

**An elite AI builder.** You think in terms of agentic systems. Building agents, evals, context engineering, and thinking in guardrails are core to who you are. You keep up with the frontier and put new capabilities to work within days, not quarters. You'd be in the top few percent of AI users at any company you've worked at. Someone who treats AI as an occasional assistant, or needs an engineer to build tooling for them, isn't the right fit here.

**A zero-to-one operator.** You've taken ambiguous, cross-team operating problems from zero to running systems as an individual contributor, with no team to hand the work to. This is unlikely to be a good fit if your experience stops at executing a scope someone else already defined.

**Marketplace-tested.** You've operated inside a marketplace or another multi-sided business and felt firsthand what it takes to balance the needs of different stakeholders on the supply and demand sides. A background built entirely on single-sided businesses, with one stakeholder type to satisfy, won't translate here.

**A finisher.** Executing what you recommend matters as much to you as the recommendation itself. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you treat strategy as your job and execution as someone else's.

**A partner who can help drive strategy collaboratively.** You work well with people who don't report to you and are a savvy cross-departmental collaborator on priorities and sequencing. If you need formal authority to effect change, this role isn't for you.

**Data-driven by reflex.** You'd rather build the query or the dashboard than argue from a hunch. This is unlikely to be a good fit if, when ambiguity hits, your first move is to guess and move on instead of digging for the number.

**At home in unresolved ambiguity.** Scope shifts as priorities do, and problems arrive unframed more often than not. That's the norm here, not an exception.

**Degree** in analytics, business or related field, with **7+ years of experience** in marketplace operations or equivalent roles.

**This Role Is NOT**

* **A people-management role.** There's no team to build or manage, at least not to start.
* **A strategy-only seat.** You'll execute what you recommend, not hand it off to someone else to run.
* **A fit for anyone who isn't already an elite AI builder.** The AI bar on this team isn't aspirational; it's the baseline we hire against.

 
**Benefits**

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Base salary**: $175,000 to $200,000.
* **Equity component**: We want the person who takes this role invested in LawnStarter delivering excellent service, and in how far AI-first operating carries this company.
* **Healthcare**: Medical, dental, and vision.
* **Fully remote (US)**: All of LawnStarter is remote. This role demands deep independent work and close partnership across a distributed, multi-country team.
* **Flexible time off**: We focus on results. Take what you need.

*LawnStarter provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. We comply with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment.*

new_roles.description:
Multi-Unit General Manager

**District Kitchen & Bar + PUBLIC eat+drink** 
Berkshire County, Massachusetts

Compensation

**$130,000–$160,000 total compensation** (base salary + performance bonus)

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, results-driven Multi-Unit General Manager to oversee two established, high-volume independent restaurants in the Berkshires. This is a senior leadership role for someone who thrives on building strong teams, driving profitability, implementing systems, and creating operational excellence.

The ideal candidate is equal parts operator, coach, and business strategist. You'll work directly with ownership to improve performance across both locations while ensuring exceptional guest experiences and a strong workplace culture.

Key Objectives

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Growing top-line revenue
* Increasing restaurant profitability
* Reducing controllable costs
* Implementing scalable systems and procedures
* Developing and retaining high-performing managers
* Improving accountability and operational consistency
* Strengthening guest satisfaction and online reputation

ResponsibilitiesBusiness Performance

* Own P&L performance for both restaurants
* Analyze financial results and identify opportunities for revenue growth and margin improvement
* Develop and execute plans to increase sales, traffic, and guest frequency
* Monitor labor, food, beverage, and operating costs
* Establish measurable KPIs and hold management teams accountable

Leadership & Team Development

* Recruit, hire, train, and develop management staff as needed
* Create a culture of accountability, professionalism, and hospitality
* Conduct regular performance reviews and coaching sessions
* Build leadership depth within both organizations
* Resolve employee issues quickly and professionally

Operations

* Ensure consistent execution of service, food quality, and hospitality standards
* Standardize systems and procedures across both locations where appropriate
* Oversee scheduling, staffing levels, inventory controls, and purchasing
* Improve efficiency and eliminate operational bottlenecks
* Maintain compliance with all health, safety, labor, and licensing requirements

Revenue Growth

* Partner with ownership on marketing and promotional initiatives
* Identify opportunities to increase guest counts, check averages, and repeat business
* Oversee private events, catering opportunities, and community partnerships
* Evaluate menu performance and pricing strategies alongside culinary leadership

Qualifications

* 5+ years of senior restaurant management experience
* Multi-unit management experience strongly preferred
* Demonstrated success improving restaurant profitability
* Strong financial acumen with deep understanding of P&L management
* Experience managing managers and building leadership teams
* Proven ability to create systems, processes, and accountability structures
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* Hospitality-first mindset combined with strong business discipline

Ideal Candidate

You are:

* Highly accountable and results-oriented
* Comfortable making difficult decisions
* Analytical and data-driven
* Skilled at motivating teams and developing leaders
* Focused on continuous improvement
* Equally comfortable in the dining room, the kitchen, and the financial statements

What We Offer

* Competitive compensation package of $130,000–$160,000 annually
* Significant performance-based bonus opportunity
* High level of autonomy and decision-making authority
* Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on two well-established restaurants
* Direct partnership with ownership on strategy and growth initiatives

To Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief note outlining:

* Your multi-unit management experience
* A specific example of improving profitability at a restaurant operation
* Why this opportunity interests you

Pay: $130,000.00 - $160,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person
