* Partner with Supply Chain on supplier readiness, long-lead planning, cost reduction, and risk mitigation.
* Partner with the Radar Operations Center and Global Infrastructure to turn field performance and maintenance data into product and process improvements to increase performance, reduce operational impacts, and decrease maintenance costs.
* Develop manufacturing KPIs and high-level dashboards for throughput, schedule metrics, yield, labor tracking, cost, quality, rework, scrap, supplier performance, and field reliability.

Team Leadership

* Establish and lead the LeoLabs Production System, creating a common operating model for safety, quality, delivery, cost and people. Implement tiered daily management, visual controls, standard work, structured problem solving, leader standard work, production flow, capacity management and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, develop, and lead a world-class manufacturing organization including manufacturing operations, production, test operations, quality, facilities, and related functions.
* Set clear ownership and metrics across the manufacturing organization.
* Build a culture of execution, urgency, accountability, safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

* 15+ years of experience in manufacturing, production operations, industrialization, factory operations, manufacturing engineering, or related operational leadership roles.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and leading a mature Lean manufacturing or production operating system, such as the Toyota Production System, including standard work, visual management, daily accountability, structured problem solving, flow, built-in quality, waste reduction and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated experience scaling production capacity, standing up production lines or facilities, and improving throughput, quality, cost, and delivery performance.
* Experience manufacturing complex, high-reliability hardware in industries such as aerospace, defense, automotive, advanced electronics, robotics, industrial automation, energy systems, RF systems, communications, space systems, or mission-critical infrastructure.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience developing greenfield or brownfield production facilities, production lines, integration sites, or manufacturing cells.
* Experience with radar, RF systems, antennas, communications systems, sensors, satellites, ground systems, aerospace systems, or other complex electromechanical products.

existing_roles.description:
**SUMMARY:** Directs production, distribution, maintenance, receiving, and supervision operations for the Plant, by performing the following duties personally or through subordinate supervisors.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Leads all departments in the plant with department supervisors (or production manager) to maintain safety, quality, and efficient production.
* Coordinates production, distribution, and warehousing in accordance with policies, principles, and established procedures.
* Develops and implements plans for efficient use of materials, machines, and employees.
* Reviews production costs and product quality and modifies production and inventory control programs to maintain and enhance profitable operation of plant.
* Directs preparation of production, human resources, and labor/costs records.
* Recommends budgets to management. Assists management in negotiation of employee contracts.
* Maintains positive working relationship with sales management and customer service management.
* Systematically reviews financial performance of the plant to recommend to management opportunities for sales growth and cost savings.
* Coordinates plant safety, environmental and training activities in cooperation with the Human Resources Department.
* Comply with company policies and procedures.
* Additional duties as assigned by management.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manages subordinate supervisors and/or production manager who supervise all plant employees. Is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of these units.
* Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.
* Responsibilities include training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**:

* High school diploma or GED plus college and/or appropriate technical courses.
* Five years experience as a proven manager
* Ten years corrugated manufacturing experience
* Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:
* College degree

**LANGUAGE SKILLS:**

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
* Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:**

* Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry.
* Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

**REASONING ABILITY:**

* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
* Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS:**

The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:

* Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation. This also supports the supervisor's role of teacher and trainer for his/her personnel.
* Cost issues in order to make daily decisions that will reduce overall costs and will help the supervisor find areas that require improvement.
* Budget development, adherence and analysis.
* Quality standards.
* Regulatory requirements including but not limited to wage and hour requirements, environmental and waste minimization, company policies, and personnel requirements including OSHA, DEQ and EEO.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**:

* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
* The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, and sit.
* The employee is occasionally required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
* The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

* The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts.
* The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions.
* The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration.
* The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

**LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES**:

The individual must posses the following:

* Superior time management skills including the ability to manage multiple issues concurrently and the ability to lead an effective and efficient meeting.
* Teaching skills in order to function effectively as a teacher for his personnel both in the technical and administrative parts of the position.
* Excellent crisis manager who demonstrates that he/she has a high emotional control under adverse conditions and can lead his/her personnel to a successful resolution.
* Excellent employee relations skills including being an active listener, understanding how to appraise personnel, applying both positive and corrective feedback, being able to resolve conflicts either involving the supervisor directly or as a third party, understands and demonstrates positive motivational skills including coaching and delegation techniques.
* Demonstrated confidence including providing a consistent leadership style with an acceptable level of professional assertiveness.
* Professional appearance to support his/her role as a managerial representative of the company.

**PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS**:

The performance of the supervisor will be measured as follows:

* **Operating standards** - the Plant Manager will need to see that all reporting staff meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the supervisor.
* **Personal growth** - while the company will provide the tools to assist the supervisor to grow professionally the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed and agreed to by the supervisor and his/her superior.

**Employee relations** - through observations the Plant Manager will be evaluated regarding his/her and his/her reporting staff's skills and advancements in the areas of motivational techniques and results, positive and corrective/constructive feedback, subordinate development and creating a positive work environment.

**Carolina Container Company is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.**

The Plant Manager will work closely with other departments and managers to ensure
  
all in-process production metrics as deliverables are being met. This team member will be focused
  
on overall safety, production deliverables and continuous improvement as we continue our growth.  
Job Duties & Responsibilities:  

* Establishing and maintaining production and shipping schedules and ensuring that quality

product is consistently delivered to customers on time and within budget for labor hours,
  
machine hours and material costs  

* Managing production operations such that equipment and employee resources are

utilized efficiently, productivity is high and product quality requirements are met and
  
exceeded  

* Ensuring that process and equipment capabilities meet or exceed company and industry

standards and requirements; implementing operations-related initiatives that result in
  
increased efficiency, improved productivity and reduced job-related costs  

* Full participation in weekly production meetings and daily work-related meetings is

expected  

* Maintaining company policies and procedures with respect to production, materials, and

equipment-related activities, ensuring that employees report labor hours, machine hours,
  
material usage and activities in accordance with company policies and procedures and
  
within the current operations management and control systems  

* Implementing operations and function-related budgeting goals and objectives;

establishing benchmarks for monthly, quarterly, and annual case production and
  
shipments, material receipts, production work-in-process completed and inventory levels
  
within the Plant Level of Operations  

* Preparing and presenting to Director of Operations, the weekly executive summary that

includes production, purchasing, shipping, receiving and inventory numbers as part of the
  
system of infernal checks and balances  

* Recruiting, selecting, training, motivating and evaluating all operations employees in

accordance with company human relations policies and procedures  

* Helping to build and manage within a team-based production environment and developing

and maintaining good working relationships between production, materials, and
  
equipment maintenance  

* Interfacing between the employees in the department and the Director of Operations, the

Executive Vice-President and President of the Company and supporting company policies,
  
goals, objectives, and initiatives  

* Ensuring that all product produced meets quality requirements in accordance with

company policy, procedures and requirements and in accordance with industry standards  

* Keeping the Management abreast of successes, progress and potential problems and

offering appropriate solutions for those problems  

* Simultaneously handling, prioritizing and resolving problems effectively
* Ensuring that shipment deadlines and budget and profitability objectives (i.e. gross margin

and operating profit) are met and exceeded on a quarterly and annual basis as established
  
by Director of Operations  

* Ensuring achievement of production metrics and shipment objectives, including labor

hours per case, machine time per case, quality and cost per case; ensure that labor and
  
machine efficiency is within company guidelines; ensuring that periodic maintenance,
  
repair, rework hours and waste are within company guidelines  

* Ascertaining that purchasing, production support, shipping and receiving performance

metrics and objectives and inventory units and balance objectives are achieved or
  
exceeded on a quarterly and annual basis while ensuring on-time delivery of quality
  
product to customers at budgeted cost per case  

* Ensuring quality products are produced and quality relationships are established and

maintained between production, materials and equipment maintenance personnel, with
  
engineering and sales, customers, subcontractors and others in the area and in the
  
industry  

* Ensuring customer complaints are fewer and of less seriousness than company targets and

objectives  

* Ensuring that reporting and supporting documentation is completed on time and in

accordance with company procedures  

* Achieving Company goals to produce quality product on time and within budget hours are

supported in theory and followed in practice

Job Qualifications:
  

* 5+ year’s relevant industrial and manufacturing experience
* Associates degree in industrial, mechanical, or electrical engineering or equivalent

experience. Manufacturing engineering and operations management an added plus  

* Relevant and current technical knowledge concerning products, materials and equipment
* Knowledge, skills and ability to understand and manage food processing activities and

production lines to provide expertise and technical support to all plant employees, to
  
make equipment, production and materials related decisions  

* Ability to maintain production planning and scheduling, shop loading, expediting and

dispatching, purchasing, shipping and receiving and inventory control functions using
  
manufacturing systems in place  

* Ability to lead and motivate teams to produce quality product, on schedule and within

budget and participate in and facilitate operations-related team meetings  

* Outstanding communication skills with proven ability to successfully lead and develop a

team  

* Excellent team leadership skills and an ability to set goals, accomplish objectives, coach

and counsel while adding to the organizational climate and culture  

* Personal characteristics reflective of a fast paced industry: high energy, self-motivated,

positive attitude, service oriented, flexible, ethical, loyal and with high degree of integrity  

* Business maturity, team orientation and proven ability to positively influence change and

ensure business discipline through periods of growth while simultaneously protecting the
  
company’s operating principles and underlying entrepreneurial culture  

* Demonstrated good judgment in prioritizing, expediting, investigating and resolving

problems and issues and fosters harmonious relations with other company employees
  
while meeting and exceeding customer requirements  

* Respect for the confidentiality of company, customer, and employee information

Competencies:  

* Managing People - Includes staff in planning, decision-making, facilitating and process

improvement; Takes responsibility for subordinates' activities; Makes self-available to staff;
  
Provides regular performance feedback; Develops subordinates' skills and encourages
  
growth; Solicits and applies customer feedback (internal and external); Fosters quality focus
  
in others; Improves processes, products, and services.; Continually works to improve
  
supervisory skills.  

* Organizational Support - Follows policies and procedures; Completes administrative tasks

correctly and on time; Supports organization's goals and values; Benefits organization
  
through outside activities; Supports affirmative action and respects diversity.  

* Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and

analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem
  
solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.  

* Quality Management - Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Demonstrates

accuracy and thoroughness.  

* Safety and Security - Observes safety and security procedures; Determines appropriate

action beyond guidelines; Reports potentially unsafe conditions; Uses equipment and
  
materials properly.  

* Strategic Thinking - Develops strategies to achieve organizational goals; Understands

organization's strengths & weaknesses; Analyzes market and competition; Identifies
  
external threats and opportunities; Adapts strategy to changing conditions.  

* Technical Skills - Assesses own strengths and weaknesses; Pursues training and

development opportunities; Strives to continuously build knowledge and skills; Shares
  
expertise with others.  
PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT: Work is performed indoors in a manufacturing  
setting with regular exposure to cold, heat, noise, and moving machines and equipment. Must be
  
able to lift to 50 lbs, push and pull up to 40 lbs, lift, stand and carry consistently, have proper hearing,
  
vision and speech capabilities. Can wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) (Hearing protection,
  
safety glasses, goggles, or shields).  
The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of
  
this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or physical
  
requirements. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign
  
duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Reasonable accommodations may be made to
  
enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

existing_roles.title: Plant Manager
existing_roles.description:
CAMS is looking for a Plant Manager at the Kings Mountain Energy Center in Kings Mountain, NC. The incumbent will have 19 direct and indirect employees. The Plant Manager is responsible for the safe, reliable, compliant, and financially responsible operation and maintenance of the Kings Mountain Energy Center.

Kings Mountain Energy Center is a 475MW natural gas-fired combined-cycle power plant. The facility features an advanced 276MW Mitsubishi M501GAC gas turbine, a Vogt Power heat recovery steam generator (HRSG), a 225MW Toshiba steam turbine generator, and a Thermal Engineering International surface condenser.

The position provides overall leadership for plant operations, maintenance, engineering support, environmental and regulatory compliance, administration, workforce development, budgeting, outage execution, and continuous improvement. The Plant Manager serves as the primary site representative to CAMS leadership, facility ownership and asset management, and is accountable for developing a high-performing organization that maximizes plant availability, reliability, efficiency, and long-term asset value. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong leadership, sound technical and business judgment, and the ability to manage a complex combined-cycle generating facility in a competitive power-market environment.

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for the safe, reliable, environmentally compliant, and cost-effective operation and maintenance of the facility.
* Establish and maintain a strong safety culture in which employees and contractors actively identify hazards, stop unsafe work, and demonstrate personal ownership of safety performance.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local environmental permits, laws, regulations, NERC requirements, OSHA requirements, company policies, and facility procedures.
* Lead and develop the plant management team and workforce, including recruiting, coaching, performance management, succession planning, qualification programs, and workforce development.
* Maintain effective working relationships with facility ownership, Asset Management, CAMS leadership, regulatory agencies, the system operator, utilities, OEMs, contractors, and other key stakeholders.
* Develop and execute annual operating plans, O&M budgets, capital plans, forecasts, and long-term maintenance strategies consistent with owner objectives and contractual requirements.
* Monitor plant financial performance and control expenditures while ensuring that short-term budget objectives do not create unacceptable safety, environmental, reliability, or long-term asset risk.
* Direct plant operations to achieve availability, reliability, heat-rate, start-reliability, capacity, and other performance objectives while meeting dispatch and commercial obligations.
* Provide leadership for maintenance strategies, preventive and predictive maintenance, corrective-maintenance backlog management, equipment reliability, root-cause analysis, and elimination of recurring failures.
* Direct planning and execution of combustion turbine, steam turbine, HRSG, generator, electrical, and balance-of-plant outages and major maintenance activities, including scope, budget, schedule, contractor performance, quality, and risk management.
* Develop and maintain multi-year outage, major-maintenance, and capital improvement plans based on equipment condition, OEM recommendations, operating profile, commercial requirements, and risk.
* Identify significant plant risks and provide CAMS leadership and ownership with timely information, alternatives, consequences, and clear recommendations for decision-making.
* Ensure appropriate critical-spares strategy, inventory controls, long-lead component planning, and equipment-obsolescence management.
* Oversee plant engineering and technical support activities, including equipment modifications, controls and logic changes, performance monitoring, capital projects, and technical problem solving.
* Ensure plant procedures, drawings, technical documentation, training materials, emergency plans, and operating records are accurate and maintained.
* Oversee administration of applicable plant contracts and agreements and ensure operational compliance with owner requirements, O&M obligations, OEM/LTSA requirements, fuel and utility agreements, and other commercial commitments.
* Maintain effective communication with Asset Management and ownership, including prompt escalation of significant safety, environmental, operational, equipment, financial, contractual, or regulatory events.
* Lead emergency response and business-continuity activities and ensure the facility is prepared for severe weather, grid emergencies, fuel interruptions, cyber events, and major equipment failures.
* Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement, and open communication across Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Compliance, and Administration.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve plant performance, reduce operating risk, optimize costs, and increase long-term asset value.
* Support CAMS fleet initiatives, peer reviews, lessons learned, workforce-development efforts, and cross-facility technical support as requested.

Other duties as assigned.

### **Qualifications and Skills**

* 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in power generation operations and maintenance, including significant leadership experience in a power plant environment.
* Prior Plant Manager, Operations Manager, Maintenance Manager, or comparable senior power-generation leadership experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated knowledge of combined-cycle power plant operations, maintenance, reliability, and major equipment systems. Experience with combustion turbines, steam turbines, HRSGs, generators, electrical systems, and balance-of-plant equipment is preferred.
* Experience with Mitsubishi M501GAC combustion turbines is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing major outages, managing contractors and OEMs, controlling outage scope and cost, and resolving emergent technical issues.
* Working knowledge of environmental, health and safety, and electric-generation regulatory requirements applicable to power plant operations.
* Demonstrated experience developing and managing O&M budgets, forecasts, capital projects, and long-term maintenance plans.
* Proven ability to lead, coach, develop, and hold accountable a multidisciplinary workforce.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, planning, and organizational skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with employees, executives, owners, regulators, contractors, and technical personnel.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred. Significant relevant power-generation leadership experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and familiarity with computerized maintenance management systems, plant historians, performance-monitoring systems, and other power-plant business systems.
* Ability to respond to plant emergencies and significant operating events outside normal business hours as required.

Other Desirable Skills

* Demonstrates visible leadership and a strong personal commitment to safety and environmental compliance.
* Balances technical, operational, financial, and commercial considerations when making decisions.
* Communicates significant risks and problems early and avoids surprises for ownership and senior leadership.
* Demonstrates strong customer service skills and the ability to build trusted relationships with facility ownership and Asset Management.
* Effectively prioritizes competing demands in a fast-changing operating environment.
* Develop people and create clear succession paths for key positions.
* Demonstrates a high degree of integrity, accountability, sound judgment, and ownership mentality.
* Ability to represent the facility and CAMS professionally with owners, regulators, industry organizations, and external stakeholders

Applicants must possess a **valid driver's license** and maintain a clean driving record, as this position requires occasional travel for company business. Candidates should be comfortable operating a vehicle as part of their job responsibilities and must meet any applicable company and insurance requirements.

CAMS offers a variety of excellent benefits. Full-time employees are offered the following: medical, dental, vision, LTD, STD, and Life insurance plans. You can even select additional “al la carte” benefits to meet all your needs. You can also enroll in our 401k, flex spending accounts for medical and childcare needs, and participate in our employee referral and tuition reimbursement programs.

Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified Applicants will not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States.

We believe in transparency and providing candidates with important information to make informed decisions. The salary range for this position will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, and location. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to skills, experience, and relevant qualifications.

This range represents the base salary and does not include other forms of compensation, such as bonuses, benefits, or equity, which may be offered in addition to the base pay. The company reserves the right to modify.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

### **Develop Great People**

* Build, lead, and develop a capable, engaged, and high-performing team.
* Lead effective hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and recognition.

### **Champion Safety, Quality & Compliance**

**What You'll Bring**

You establish clear expectations, create ownership, follow through on commitments, recognize strong performance, and make sure improvements stick.

Most importantly, you're comfortable being where the work happens. You can move effectively between reviewing plant financial performance, coaching a leader, solving an operational problem, reviewing equipment reliability, and walking the manufacturing floor with the team.

If you are energized by building strong teams, strengthening manufacturing systems, solving complex problems, and creating sustainable operational results, we'd love to hear from you.

existing_roles.title: Director of Technical Operations
existing_roles.description:
### **Description**

At Pacific Seafood, we do more than just provide the world with the healthiest proteins on the planet. We are a family-owned, excellence-driven organization committed to being the brand of choice in the marketplace and the employer of choice in the community. We believe in servant leadership, investing in our team members’ personal and professional growth, and rewarding performance. We live by the core values of our Diamond Philosophy: Teamwork, Productivity, Quality, and Excellence—which means consistently doing your best and *always* striving to do better.
  
  
**Summary:**

We are seeking a dynamic, solutions-oriented **Director of Technology Operations** to lead, scale, and optimize IT operations for our enterprise. Serving as a strategic partner to leadership and business unit heads across geographies, this role is accountable for the reliability, agility, and continuous evolution of our enterprise technology ecosystem.

The ideal candidate is a transformative, hands-on leader who blends deep technical fluency with strong financial stewardship and operational maturity. Rather than introducing rigid bureaucracy, this leader takes a pragmatic, evolutionary approach—fine-tuning existing workflows, aligning IT service delivery with measurable business outcomes, and fostering an empowering, "Best in Class" culture across Service Desk, Project Management Office (PMO), Infrastructure, and Enterprise Applications.

Because our team members are our greatest asset and strength, this role directly assesses the VP’s direct reports and the next level of leaders, identifies strengths and gaps, and ensures each leader has a practical development plan. The Director also evaluates reporting relationships, spans of control, role clarity, and succession depth, and uses a working knowledge of income statements and balance sheets to connect people decisions to business results.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise IT Service Delivery & Service Desk Operations**

* **Support Leadership:** Direct the strategy and daily execution of end-user support, including the IT Service Desk, Desktop Support, Field Services, Depot/Procurement, and VIP/Executive Support across multiple time zones.
* **SLA & Throughput Excellence:** Establish, monitor, and enforce aggressive Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure consistent, predictable service throughput—even during critical end-of-month, end-of-quarter, or high-volume operational periods.
* **End-to-End Lifecycle Management:** Oversee the complete IT lifecycle of internal and customer-facing systems, including enterprise workstations, telephony, infrastructure, and specialized operational/manufacturing hardware.
* **Operational Readiness & Business Continuity:** Lead contingency planning, risk surfacing, and operational readiness initiatives to protect business continuity and minimize disruptions during organizational transitions or major system cutovers.

**2. ITSM, ITIL Frameworks & IT Governance**

* **ITSM & ITIL Maturity:** Own, design, and continuously optimize core ITIL processes—including Incident, Problem, Request, Change, Escalation, and Knowledge Management—within enterprise platforms.
* **IT Intake & Demand Management:** Architect and govern a centralized IT Intake process to evaluate, prioritize, and route incoming business requests, ensuring resource allocation aligns with strategic corporate objectives and operational capacity.
* **Enterprise Governance & Compliance:** Establish pragmatic IT governance models, internal controls, and compliance frameworks that safeguard enterprise data and infrastructure without impeding business agility.
* **Knowledge & Self-Service Enablement:** Drive continuous improvement in knowledge base creation, documentation standards, and automated self-service tools to empower end-users and accelerate first-contact resolution.

**3. Project Management Office (PMO) & Digital Transformation**

* **PMO Leadership & Tollgate Governance:** Develop, deploy, and oversee formalized project management methodologies and tools. Serve as the executive tollgate for technology initiatives to ensure requirements are rigorously defined, scoped, and aligned with strategic goals.
* **Enterprise System Implementations:** Lead cross-functional execution for major digital transformation initiatives, including ERP migrations, CRM rollouts, and M&A technology integrations.
* **AI & Automation Readiness:** Champion the pragmatic adoption of emerging technologies and AI-driven workflows across IT operations to automate routine tasks, enhance reporting accuracy, and elevate enterprise productivity.

**4. Continuous Improvement & Lean Operations**

* **Lean Six Sigma Execution:** Embed Lean and Continuous Improvement methodologies into daily IT operations to eliminate waste, reduce turnaround times, and streamline cross-departmental workflows.
* **Root Cause & Corrective Action:** Partner closely with all IT Operations teams on deep failure-mode analysis and root-cause corrective actions to permanently resolve recurring technical issues and business impacts.
* **Asset & Inventory Optimization:** Reframe IT hardware, spare parts, and demo/recon pools as actively managed operational assets—optimizing space utilization, procurement costing, redistribution, and lifecycle disposition.

**5. Customer Satisfaction & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* **Customer-Centric Culture:** Champion an unwavering focus on internal and external customer satisfaction, transforming IT from a transactional support function into a proactive, trusted business enabler.
* **Executive & Departmental Alignment:** Foster transparent, collaborative partnerships with Finance, Manufacturing, Distribution, Quality, Engineering, and Sales leadership to ensure technology roadmaps directly support revenue and operational goals.
* **Voice of the Customer:** Implement regular satisfaction tracking, feedback loops, and executive business reviews to measure stakeholder sentiment and drive targeted service enhancements.

**6. Financial Stewardship & Resource Optimization**

* **Multi-Million-Dollar P&L Management:** Develop, justify, and manage a $15M–$30M+ IT operations budget, maintaining strict fiscal discipline across OPEX, CAPEX, vendor contracts, and software licensing.
* **Data-Driven Economics:** Apply rigorous cost-benefit and repair-versus-replace analyses to hardware maintenance, vendor agreements, and service models, identifying opportunities to reduce operational costs while improving service quality.
* **Vendor & Outsourced Partner Management:** Negotiate and manage contracts with third-party vendors, hardware suppliers, and managed service providers to ensure accountability and maximum return on investment.

**7. Talent Development & Organizational Leadership**

* **Inspirational People Leadership:** Lead, mentor, and coach a diverse, geographically dispersed organization of managers, engineers, analysts, and technicians.
* **Cross-Training & Team Resilience:** Eliminate single-point dependencies by building structured cross-training programs, clear career pathways, and flexible skill coverage across teams.
* **High-Accountability & Morale:** Cultivate a high-morale, low-turnover environment rooted in psychological safety, diversity, equity, and inclusion, while holding staff to clear performance standards through active coaching and accountability.

  

### **What you bring to Pacific Seafood**

**Required:**

* **Executive or Senior Leadership Track Record:** 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in IT Operations, Service Delivery, or Technical Operations, including 5+ years at the Director or Senior level within a complex, multi-site, or enterprise environment.
* **Proven Operational Impact:** Demonstrated history of scaling support teams, managing multi-million-dollar budgets, and delivering measurable reductions in operational costs and ticket turnaround times.
* **Enterprise Transformation:** Hands-on experience leading large-scale ERP/CRM transitions, ITIL/ITSM framework implementations, and post-M&A systems integration.
* **Cross-Industry Fluency:** Strong operational understanding of corporate IT alongside manufacturing, distribution, engineering, or field-service environments.

**Education & Certifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor of Science in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related technical discipline. Preferred; advanced degrees, e.g., Master of Business Administration (MBA)

**Certifications, not required, but highly desired:**

* ITIL Certification
* Lean Six Sigma Certification
* Project Management Professional or active PMI affiliation strongly preferred.

**Physical Requirements**  
  
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a team member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the team member:

* Must be available to work Monday -Friday during regular working hours, with occasional weekend duties.
* Ability to maintain a stationary position 80% of the time, with intermittent walking, standing, bending, reaching, and/or crawling.
* Ability to move and transport documents, equipment, or other items weighing up to 50 pounds across various locations for different team members, departments, and events.
* Capable of occasional travel as required by duties, demonstrating efficiency and effectiveness in diverse locations.
* Capable of operating a computer and other office productivity machinery, including a calculator, copy machine, and printer.
* Capable of frequently communicating with team members and stakeholders, accurately conveying detailed or important spoken instructions.
* Capable of perceiving visuals for activities such as preparing and analyzing data and figures, transcribing, viewing a computer screen, and engaging in extensive reading.

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job.*

**Working Conditions**  
The working environment characteristics described here are representative of those a team member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the team member is exposed to:

* Traditional office environment
* Standard office equipment (computers, printers, phones, etc.)
* Well-illuminated environment
* Quiet to moderate noise level
* Occasional travel via car or plane to regional facilities, events, etc.
* Occasional subtle and mild scents related to operational facilities
* Occasional access to operational or warehouse facilities

  

### **Benefits**

**Total Compensation**

At Pacific Seafood your base wage is only a portion of your overall compensation package. We invest in our Team Members through a comprehensive and attractive total rewards package, including but not limited to:

* Health insurance benefits options, including medical, prescription, vision, dental, basic group life and short term disability.
* Flexible spending accounts for health flex and dependent care expenses
* 401(k) Retirement Plan options with generous annual company profit sharing match
* Paid time off for all regular FT team members, to include sick days, holiday pay, vacation, and personal time
* Employee Assistance Program- Confidential professional counseling, financial, and legal assistance provided at no charge to Team Members and immediate family members
* Product purchase program

Pacific Seafood is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

### **About Pacific Seafood**

At Pacific Seafood, we do more than just provide the world with the healthiest proteins on the planet. We are an excellence-driven organization committed to being the brand of choice in the marketplace and the employer of choice in the community. We believe in servant leadership, investing in our team members, and rewarding performance. We live by the core values of our Diamond Philosophy: Quality, Teamwork, Productivity, and Excellence—which means consistently doing your best and always striving to do better.

**Preparedness today, safer tomorrow.**

Emergent is a leading public health company that delivers protective and life-saving solutions to

**Why This Role Matters**

At Emergent, our work protects communities and strengthens global health security. As **Head of IT Infrastructure & Operations**, you will lead the organization’s global technology infrastructure and end-user services.

Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, the Senior Director, Head of IT Infrastructure & Operations leads the strategy, engineering, security, reliability, and day-to-day operation of the company’s global technology infrastructure and end-user services. The role is accountable for resilient, secure, compliant, and cost-effective delivery across hybrid cloud, data centers, networks, compute, storage, workplace technology, service management, collaboration, and infrastructure platforms supporting a global 24/7 business and regulated operations. The position modernizes the infrastructure operating model through automation, observability, data-driven service management, and responsible use of AI, while maintaining disciplined lifecycle, continuity, validation, and vendor governance.

  

**What You'll Do**

*Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

**Enterprise leadership and strategy**

* Serve as a member of the CIO’s IT Leadership Team and act as the executive owner for enterprise infrastructure and operations capabilities.

**Operational excellence, service management, and employee experience**

* Lead global 24/7 infrastructure operations, service desk, workplace services, major incident management, problem management, change enablement, configuration and asset practices, capacity management, and service continuity.

* Build mature monitoring, observability, event management, and command-center practices to identify degradation early, accelerate restoration, and drive permanent corrective action.
* Continuously improve employee technology experience across offices, laboratories, manufacturing and distribution environments, remote work, and executive support.

**Cyber resilience, continuity, and compliance**

* Partner with the Chief Information Security Officer and Quality organization to embed secure-by-design, zero-trust, privileged-access, vulnerability, patching, hardening, segmentation, backup protection, recovery, and logging requirements into infrastructure services.
* Own infrastructure disaster recovery and technology continuity capabilities, including business-aligned recovery objectives, dependency mapping, crisis response integration, documented recovery procedures, and regular exercises.
* Ensure infrastructure services meet applicable company policies and regulated-life-sciences requirements, including controlled change, documentation, qualification or validation, data integrity, audit readiness, and evidence retention where required.
* Ensure operational risks, exceptions, and control gaps are visible, assigned, prioritized, and remediated or formally accepted.

**Automation, AI-enabled operations, and data**

* Develop an automation-first operating model using infrastructure as code, orchestration, self-service, policy as code, automated testing, and repeatable deployment and recovery patterns.
* Adopt AI-enabled operations responsibly to improve event correlation, knowledge retrieval, service desk support, capacity forecasting, anomaly detection, and operational decision support, with appropriate human oversight, security, privacy, records, and compliance controls.
* Create trusted operational data and dashboards that enable trend analysis, predictive insight, cost transparency, risk prioritization, and measurable continual improvement.
* Build workforce capability in cloud, automation, AI, cybersecurity, service reliability, and modern engineering practices.

**Financial, supplier, and talent leadership**

* Own infrastructure and operations financial planning, forecasting, cloud financial management, contract optimization, and investment prioritization.
* Lead strategic sourcing activities, including RFPs, RFIs, SOWs, contract and service-level negotiations, supplier performance, concentration risk, exit planning, and third-party resilience.
* Lead, develop, and retain a diverse global team; clarify accountabilities, succession, cross-training, on-call expectations, and skills plans across employees, managed service providers, and specialist partners.
* Create a culture of ownership, disciplined execution, transparency, collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
  

The above statements describe the general nature of work performed in this job. They are not an exhaustive list of duties, and other duties may be assigned.

  

**What You Bring**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Advanced degree is preferred.
* Typically 15+ years of progressive technology experience, including 7+ years leading multiple infrastructure, operations, engineering, or service delivery teams in a complex global enterprise.
* Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide infrastructure transformation and operating-model change in a highly regulated environment; life-sciences, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or manufacturing experience is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated accountability for global, business-critical, 24/7 services delivered through a mix of internal teams, public cloud, SaaS, IaaS, PaaS, colocation, telecommunications, managed services, and outsourcing partners.

**Required Skills and Abilities**

* Executive leadership, business acumen, financial stewardship, and the ability to communicate complex technology choices as business value, risk, resilience, cost, and employee impact.
* Deep working knowledge of hybrid cloud, enterprise networking, compute, storage, backup and recovery, identity dependencies, endpoint and workplace technology, collaboration, telephony, monitoring, observability, and service management.
* Experience with modern engineering and operations practices, including automation, infrastructure as code, configuration management, APIs, DevSecOps, site reliability concepts, capacity engineering, and technology lifecycle management.
* Ability to establish metrics and use operational, experience, risk, and financial data to prioritize work and demonstrate outcomes.
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity infrastructure controls and close partnership with security teams on zero trust, segmentation, vulnerability and patch management, privileged access, secure configuration, logging, resilience, and incident response.
* Experience designing, testing, and improving business continuity and disaster recovery capabilities across complex application and infrastructure dependencies.
* Knowledge of cGMP expectations and experience supporting validated or qualified technology in regulated life-sciences environments, including change control, documentation, data integrity, and audit readiness.
* Experience governing AI-enabled operational use cases with appropriate controls for security, privacy, compliance, transparency, reliability, and human oversight.
* Proven ability to lead in a matrixed environment, build coalitions, influence executives, negotiate with suppliers, and manage competing priorities during incidents and transformation.
* Strong talent leadership, coaching, succession planning, organizational design, sourcing strategy, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive influencing skills.

**Preferred Knowledge and Credentials**

Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

**Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.**

**Role Description**
--------------------

Form Energy is looking for an experienced Senior Director of Quality to join our battery manufacturing organization. In this role you will lead the Quality department for Form Energy. Your scope will be company-wide and your team will implement systems and processes that ensure products are designed, manufactured and shipped to the highest levels of performance, reliability, and quality.

This role is for an executive leader with experience developing new technologies and bringing high-volume manufacturing facilities to life. You will provide vision, strategy and leadership to help Form achieve manufacturing scale, cost-reduction, and daily operation execution.

As the key driver for shipping the highest quality products, you will thrive when working closely with leadership and cross-functional teams throughout the product development lifecycle, from early R&D to validation testing, pilot builds, and ultimately commercial production of customer-facing products.

*Relocation assistance is available.*

### **What you'll do:**

* Develop and sustain a world-class quality management system powered by a highly-trained, flexible, and proactive staff
* Maintain product risk profiles and manage quality systems to ensure Form Energy is meeting or exceeding risk expectations
* Ensure Form Energy production operations are releasing only conforming products to our customers
* Communicate key risks and opportunities to leadership and provide direction to resolve top issues and drive definitive corrective action
* Plan and efficiently manage Quality resources (labor, OpEx, and CapEx) and report on department performance and needs
* Communicate Form Energy's commitment to quality with internal and external interested parties
* Drive a customer-focused culture anchored by strong individual ownership and accountability

### **What you'll bring:**

* At least 10 years experience in quality, manufacturing, or manufacturing engineering
* At least 5 years in a senior-leader / site-leader quality role, demonstrating a clear record of success in building industry-leading teams that can execute in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Expertise in building Quality Management Systems (e.g., IATF 16949, ISO9001).
* Highly technical background, with a strong foundation in logical reasoning that allows for a steep learning curve and the ability to adapt to new technologies
* Excellent leadership, project management, communication, and organizational skills
* Bachelor’s Degree (or higher) in Engineering

### **Where you'll work:**

This role is based at Form Factory 1 in Weirton, WV—an easy commute from the city of Pittsburgh, PA. This 550,000-square-foot facility is our hub for high-volume battery production and a leader in the new era of American energy manufacturing. **Relocation assistance is available.**

*#LI-Onsite*

*Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.*

*When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.*

*To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.*

*If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.*  
  
*Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will* ***never*** *solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.*

**Champion Safety, Quality, and Compliance**  
  
You'll reinforce safety and quality expectations, identify and escalate risks, and support audits, corrective actions, standards, and operational controls. You'll also have the authority to stop work when safety, quality, or compliance concerns arise and to initiate appropriate corrective or containment activities.  
  
**What You'll Bring**

* Experience leading teams, supporting cross-functional projects, improving operational processes, or preparing teams for operational changes.
* Lean, Six Sigma, PMP, or a similar professional certification.

  
**Why This Role Stands Out**  
  
This role offers the opportunity to:  

* Lead teams in a growing and evolving electric vehicle business.
* Influence site performance across safety, quality, productivity, cost, and customer service.
* Develop employees and strengthen leadership capability.
* Use data and continuous improvement methods to solve real operational challenges.
* Work closely with site and functional leaders while maintaining hands-on visibility across production, warehouse, inventory, and shipping and receiving operations.

  
**Work Environment and Travel**  
  
This is a hands-on operations leadership position that regularly works throughout production, warehouse, inventory, and shipping and receiving areas. The role requires the ability to walk and stand for extended periods, occasionally access elevated work areas, and occasionally lift and carry up to 25 pounds. The environment may include moving equipment, warehouse traffic, varying temperatures, noise, and required personal protective equipment such as safety glasses, a safety vest, hearing protection, and safety footwear.  
  
The position also requires flexibility for up to 15% travel.  
  
USD 111,500.00 - 185,900.00 per year

The base salary may vary within the anticipated base pay range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate's knowledge, skills, and abilities. Position may be eligible for additional compensation that may include an incentive program.  
  
**Benefits:**

Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave.

existing_roles.description:
Vera Therapeutics is a commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on the pursuit of truth in science to transform medicine in autoimmune disease, starting with the kidney. Vera Therapeutics’ flagship commercial product is TRUTAKNATM (atacicept-vymj), a B-cell activating factor (BAFF) and A proliferation-inducing ligand *(*APRIL) inhibitor. Vera Therapeutics is evaluating multiple diseases where the reduction of autoantibodies through inhibition of BAFF and APRIL may prove clinically meaningful. Vera Therapeutics was founded in 2016 and is based in Brisbane, California. To learn more, visit www.veratx.com.

At Vera, our values are the cornerstone of our culture and guide how we work together every day. We lead with empathy, act with an owner’s mindset, demand clarity, work without fences, and execute with urgency because patients are counting on us. From how we hire and develop our people to how we advance rigorous science, we are building a team committed to transforming medicine in autoimmune diseases, starting with the kidney.

**Position Summary:**

The Vice President, Manufacturing Operations will report to the SVP Product Development and Manufacturing (PD&T) and will be responsible for leading the transition from a clinical-stage organization to an effective commercial manufacturing organization. As a key partner to the SVP PD&T, the candidate will lead and develop a best-in-class manufacturing and supply chain team that can collaboratively work across functions to enable commercial launch of our lead product into global markets. While working with internal teams, such as quality, regulatory, commercial, and finance, and external contract service providers, the individual is responsible for ensuring that the end-to-end supply chain is set up to meet the global commercial product demand with keen eye towards continuous process improvement.

**Responsibilities:**

* Leads the manufacturing and supply chain teams, providing leadership aligned with Vera values resulting in a high performing organization
* Contributes to the strategic leadership of Vera’s late-stage programs acting as a strong team player
* Participate in sales and operations planning (S&OP) and Product Development Teams representing the Product Development and Manufacturing function
* Create synergy and knowledge sharing to enable optimal production planning processes to balance supply/demand risks
* Serves as a single point of contact to manage end-to-end global supply chain and foster the needed supplier relationships to drive excellence using appropriate metrics
* Serves as a strategic thought leader to craft and manage commercial supply contracts with an eye towards life cycle extension programs
* Create, develop and manage necessary tools for end-to-end demand/supply planning
* Provide strategic direction, technical guidance, and long-range planning for late-stage programs: BLA-enabling studies through BLA submission, commercial launch, and sustaining operations
* Develop and manage department budgets and ensure fiscal responsibility for manufacturing operations
* Develop fit for purpose operational processes and systems to support supplier metrics and other tools to enable continuous improvement / process excellence
* Willingness to take on additional duties and responsibilities as assigned, and to adapt to changes in job scope as organizational needs evolve

**Qualifications:**

* Master's degree required. PhD preferred. Degree in Life Sciences or Engineering preferred
* 15+ years of relevant experience from biopharmaceutical manufacturing required.
* 5+ years of senior-level line management experience leading other leaders required
* Proven track record of creating business results
* Deep technical, operational, regulatory, strategic, and quality expertise, along with a proven track record of leading late-stage programs in innovative biotech or pharmaceutical organizations
* Experience with operating and navigating regulatory requirements including authoring and reviewing BLAs and interacting with regulatory authorities
* Solid understanding of drug development within the biopharmaceutical industry
* Experience within development and manufacturing of monoclonal antibodies or related field preferred
* Excellent interpersonal skills, collaborative leadership style
* Leads by example in recognizing and modeling Vera values
* Learning agility: ability to seek input, make connections, recognize patterns that lead to effective decision-making and action
* Proven ability to thoughtfully evaluate processes, identify opportunities for improvement and successfully execute on those plans
* Strong communication skills (oral & written); able to effectively interact with all levels internally and externally – able to tailor communications to the audience to achieve desired results
* Attention to detail with ability to move easily between hands-on work and strategic thinking

* Strong leadership skills with a desire to nurture, train, and grow the existing finance group
* Demonstrated ability to influence and deliver results in a virtual (outsourced) environment

Vera Therapeutics Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer.

existing_roles.description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

**About Blue Origin**  
We are a team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are relentlessly committed to a culture of safety. These positions will directly impact the history of space exploration and will require your commitment and detailed attention towards safe and repeatable spaceflight. Join us in lowering the cost of access to space and enabling Blue Origin's vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth.

  

As a Sr. Director for Manufacturing at Blue Origin’s manufacturing, production, and launch facilities, this role will have a direct impact on the success of Blue’s mission.

We are looking for senior leaders to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required.

  

**About This Opportunity**  
Blue Origin is actively building its senior manufacturing and operations leadership team across multiple sites. We are seeking an experienced Sr. Director with a strong aerospace background to lead high-performing teams in support of our rocket production program. This role will span the following functional areas:

Manufacturing and Integration
  
Provides senior leadership across production operations including structural fabrication, thermal protection systems, systems integration, testing, and final assembly for Blue Origin’s booster manufacturing. Responsible for establishing and maintaining process controls, driving production efficiency, and ensuring safe, repeatable spaceflight hardware delivery at all stages of the product lifecycle. This role will also provide leadership across integration operations supporting the assembly and verification of complex space systems, launch vehicles, and propulsion hardware. Accountable for coordinating cross-functional teams to ensure the safe, on-time integration of hardware in alignment with engineering requirements, mission assurance standards, and program milestones.

**Key Responsibilities:**  
Leaders across these functional areas are expected to:
  

* Lead and develop teams of Managers, Senior Managers, and Directors driving manufacturing and operations execution across space and propulsion programs
* Champion a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement across all functional teams
* Own departmental KPIs, budgets, staffing plans, and capital project portfolios
* Partner with Program Management, Site Leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders to meet production schedules and customer expectations
* Drive process definition, development, deployment, and improvement initiatives including Lean Manufacturing and root cause analysis
* Collaborate with engineering teams to advance Design for Manufacturability principles and accelerate the transition from development to production
* Implement and mature production frameworks that support world-class manufacturing capabilities
* Communicate and enforce mission assurance and safety principles throughout the organization
* Recruit, develop, coach, and mentor talent at all levels of the organization

  
**Minimum Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial, Aerospace, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience
* 15 or more years of progressive experience in aerospace manufacturing or a closely related industry, such as launch vehicles, aircraft, spacecraft systems, or defense
* 5 or more years in a senior leadership role managing managers and large, cross-functional teams
* Demonstrated experience leading manufacturing and operations teams in fast-paced, complex environments

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Master's degree, MBA, or advanced degree in a relevant engineering or business field
* Prior experience in aerospace environments supporting space hardware, rocket propulsion, or other mission-critical, high-value components
* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, the Toyota Production System, or Six Sigma; Black Belt certification preferred
* Experience transitioning manufacturing capabilities from development and prototyping into full-rate production
* Knowledge of fabrication processes including machining, welding, composites, additive manufacturing, cleaning, and non-destructive testing
* Experience with facility activation, new production line startup, or multi-site manufacturing operations
* Proficiency with MRP/ERP, PLM, and Manufacturing Execution Systems

  

Base Pay Range for:

WA applicants is $203,165.00 - $284,430.30

**Other site ranges may differ**

  

**Culture Statement**

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

  

**Export Control Regulations**

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

  

**Background Check**

* Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical  

  

**Benefits**

* Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
* Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
* Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.  

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Blue Origin is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified and dedicated work force. Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws.

  

**Affirmative Action and Disability Accommodation**

Applicants wishing to receive information on Blue Origin’s Affirmative Action Plans, or applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation in order to participate in the application and/or interview process, please contact us at EEOCompliance@blueorigin.com . Please note this is a publicly managed inbox. Please do not include any personal medical information in your request.
