existing_roles.description:
**Director, New Product Introduction (NPI) & Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)**

Round Rock, Texas | Onsite | Full-Time

**Reports to:** CFO/CEO

**Works closely with:** Director of Operations/Engineering/R&D, Quality, Purchasing, Production, Program Management and external suppliers

**Travel:** Approximately 25%-35%, primarily to supplier locations

**Role structure:** Hands-on director role; initially an individual contributor leading cross-functional work

**Role Summary**

The Director of NPI & PLM leads the transition of new and modified products from development into stable production. The role coordinates product documentation, supplier readiness, pilot builds, production handoff and lifecycle changes across Ametrine and its manufacturing partners.

This position is focused on practical execution. The Director will work directly with cut-and-sew partners and other suppliers to ensure products can be produced repeatedly at the required quality, capacity and schedule. The role also helps develop alternate sources and contingency plans across fabric, metallization, printing, DWR treatment and cut-and-sew operations.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**New Product Introduction**

* Maintain the NPI schedule for new products, product changes and manufacturing transfers.
* Coordinate requirements, design release, sourcing, prototype builds, pilot production, validation and production handoff.
* Use clear stage gates, owners, due dates and readiness checklists.
* Identify schedule, supplier, material, quality and capacity risks early and drive actions to closure.
* Provide concise status updates covering progress, open decisions, risks and next steps.

**Prototype-to-Production Transfer**

* Work with Engineering and R&D to review designs for manufacturability and production readiness.
* Prepare or coordinate BOMs, routings, work instructions, technical packages, inspection points and packaging requirements.
* Lead prototype, pilot and first-production builds at Ametrine and supplier locations.
* Capture lessons learned and ensure changes are reflected in released documentation.
* Confirm that Operations and suppliers are ready before a product is released to routine production.

**Cut-and-Sew and Supplier Readiness**

* Work onsite with cut-and-sew partners to establish and improve production methods.
* Review patterns, sewing specifications, fixtures, templates, work instructions and inspection requirements.
* Assess supplier labor, equipment, training, floor space, quality controls and available capacity.
* Develop practical ramp plans and verify production rates through actual builds.
* Support supplier training and resolve manufacturability, throughput and quality issues during launch.
* Track supplier actions and escalate missed commitments or unsupported plans.

**Product Lifecycle Management**

* Maintain control of released BOMs, specifications, approved materials, suppliers, routings and product revisions.
* Coordinate engineering changes and assess their impact on inventory, suppliers, schedule, testing and customer requirements.
* Ensure the correct product configuration is used for each order and customer.
* Support PLM process and system improvements, including appropriate integration with ERP/MRP.
* Maintain orderly lifecycle records from product introduction through sustainment and retirement.

**Supply-Chain Resilience**

* Maintain a process-level supply-chain map covering fabric, metallization, printing, DWR, cut and sew, accessories and final delivery.
* Identify bottlenecks, long-lead items, single-source dependencies and supplier-capacity risks.
* Develop and qualify alternate sources where practical.
* Create contingency plans for specialized processes that cannot be economically dual-sourced.
* Coordinate source qualification with Operations, Purchasing, Engineering and Quality.
  

**Quality and Process Control**

* Partner with Quality to define process controls, inspection requirements and first-article expectations.
* Support supplier qualification, process reviews, root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Monitor first-pass yield, defects, rework and launch-related issues.
* Ensure production methods remain consistent with approved documentation and customer requirements.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Lead NPI work through influence across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Purchasing and suppliers.
* Maintain clear owners, deadlines and escalation paths.
* Coordinate with the Director of Operations so new-product timelines and supplier readiness are aligned with the production plan.
* Support communication and coordination between Ametrine Inc. and Ametrine Ltd. where product development activities overlap.

**Success Measures**

* NPI milestones completed on schedule
* Prototype-to-pilot and pilot-to-production cycle time
* Supplier readiness and capacity verification completed before launch
* Percentage of critical supply-chain nodes with an alternate source or documented contingency
* Launch first-pass yield, rework and defect performance
* Completeness and accuracy of BOMs, routings, work instructions and product revisions
* Timely closure of supplier, manufacturing-readiness and lifecycle risks

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, industrial technology, textiles, supply chain or a related field; equivalent directly relevant experience may be considered.
* Eight or more years of relevant experience in NPI, manufacturing engineering, supplier development, PLM, product transfer or contract manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience moving physical products from prototype through pilot and into production.
* Experience working directly with external manufacturers or suppliers.
* Working knowledge of BOMs, routings, work instructions, engineering changes and configuration control.
* Experience with ERP/MRP and PLM or related product-data systems.
* Strong project planning, follow-through, problem-solving and written communication skills.
* Ability to work onsite in Round Rock and travel approximately 25%-35%.
* U.S. citizenship required due to the defense-related nature of the company’s work.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with technical textiles, sewn products, outdoor equipment, military products, automotive soft goods, medical textiles, inflatables or related manufacturing.
* Experience with cut-and-sew production methods, patterns, line balancing or labor standards.
* Experience with coated, laminated, printed or metallized fabrics.
* Defense, aerospace or government-contract manufacturing experience.
* Experience qualifying secondary suppliers or developing business-continuity plans.
* PMP, Lean Six Sigma, APICS or similar certification.

**Working Style**

* Hands-on and comfortable working at supplier facilities and on production floors
* Organized, practical and attentive to manufacturing details
* Able to communicate effectively with engineers, operators, supplier managers and company leadership
* Persistent in following actions through completion
* Comfortable balancing several product introductions and production issues at the same time
* Focused on building useful processes without unnecessary bureaucracy

existing_roles.title: Director, Industrial Engineering
existing_roles.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
------------------

Anduril's Manufacturing Engineering Team is seeking a Director, Industrial Engineering to lead IE strategy and execution for the Air Defense & Strike (AD&S) division. The Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware — including static equipment, moving ground equipment, sensors, undersea, and flight vehicles — and scaling these products across our production footprint, including our new 5M sq ft manufacturing facility, Arsenal-1.

Industrial Engineering at Anduril operates in a matrix with a Center of Excellence (COE) and embedded IEs directly into the divisions they support. Every embedded IE takes day-to-day direction and priorities from their business line, while the central IE organization provides the methodology, standards, tools, mentorship, career development, surge coverage, and cross-divisional visibility that make each individual IE more effective than they could be on their own. The Director, IE — AD&S is the senior IE leader dedicated to one of Anduril's highest-growth, most operationally complex divisions — owning the IE strategy, team, and results for AD&S and operating as a peer member of the division's production leadership team.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
------------------

As the Director, Industrial Engineering — AD&S, you will own the industrial engineering function for the Air Defense & Strike division end-to-end. You will build, lead, and develop the IE team embedded in AD&S — hiring the right people, designing the team structure, and setting the IE agenda in lockstep with the division's production strategy and ramp trajectory and COE standards and enterprise vision / system. You report to the Director of Industrial Engineering (central IE CoE) and sit as a peer alongside AD&S production leadership, connected to the VP of Production, Director of Manufacturing Engineering, and Program Directors who shape division priorities.

This is a division-level leadership role with enterprise accountability. You are not inheriting a mature, steady-state operation — AD&S is in active ramp across multiple product lines, standing up new production systems, scaling from prototype through low-rate into full-rate production, and doing so at a pace that demands IE leadership who can build the plane while flying it. You will define what IE looks like for AD&S: which capabilities to stand up first, how to staff and structure the team, where to invest in labor standards, layouts, simulation, and capacity planning, and how IE integrates into the division's NPI and production ramp cadence.

You will translate company-wide IE standards and the Manufacturing Development Plan (MDP) into AD&S-specific execution — adapting central methodology to the division's unique product mix, production maturity, and operational tempo while maintaining consistency with enterprise IE standards and Core 4 reporting. You are accountable for IE outcomes across the division: labor standards coverage, layout quality, line balance efficiency, capacity model accuracy, and the measurable impact of IE on AD&S production performance.

The right person for this role is a seasoned IE or manufacturing engineering leader who thrives in start-up and ramp environments — someone who has built teams from scratch, stood up production systems, and driven measurable operational impact in fast-moving, complex manufacturing. You have deep technical credibility in IE fundamentals but lead through strategy and people: setting vision, building organizational capability, and creating the systems that let a growing team deliver at scale. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and operating at the intersection of divisional execution and enterprise IE strategy. You communicate with clarity and conviction to senior leadership and are energized by the challenge of building something new in a high-stakes environment.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

**Divisional IE Strategy and Execution**

* Own the IE strategy for AD&S — defining the roadmap, capability priorities, and investment plan aligned to the division's ramp trajectory, NPI pipeline, and business objectives.
* Translate company-wide IE standards and the MDP process into AD&S-specific execution — ensuring IE deliverables (labor standards, layouts, line balances, capacity models) are completed at the right maturity gates and integrated into division planning.
* Drive Core 4 metrics performance (labor hours per unit, line balance efficiency, throughput, units per square foot) — setting targets, tracking results, and ensuring IE work moves the numbers that matter to AD&S. IE provides the roadmap to scale.
* Serve as the primary IE interface to AD&S leadership for capacity questions, ramp feasibility, layout approvals, make-vs-buy analysis, and production system design. Connect AD&S needs to central IE capabilities and enterprise resources.

**Team Building and Leadership**

* Build the AD&S IE team into a high-performing, right-sized organization — designing the structure, defining roles, leading hiring, and onboarding IEs, IE Leads, and IE Technicians aligned to the division's product lines and production stages.
* Directly manage the embedded IE team — setting expectations, driving accountability, conducting performance reviews, and investing in the growth and career development of every team member. Own the headcount plan and budget.
* Develop high-potential talent, build succession depth, and ensure every IE is proficient in core methodology (time studies, MODAPTS/MTM, line balancing, layout design, capacity modeling, Core 4 measurement).

**Production System Design and NPI**

* Lead IE involvement in production line stand-ups and NPI ramps — from process characterization and layout design through labor standards development, line balancing, rate-readiness validation, and system optimization.
* Own production line and workstation layout design — cell configurations, material flow, equipment placement, and spatial planning for both low-rate and full-rate production using simulation-backed approaches.
* Drive capacity planning and production modeling — ensuring AD&S has accurate capacity models, proactively identifying bottlenecks and constraints, and supporting capital investment decisions with IE analysis.

**Cross-Functional Partnership and Communication**

* Operate as a peer member of the AD&S production leadership team — shaping production strategy, influencing capital and staffing decisions, and representing IE in all forums where production decisions are made.
* Build strong working relationships across Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Program Management, and Facilities. Represent AD&S IE in cross-divisional forums, bringing enterprise best practices back to the division.
* Be present on the floor. Walk the lines, build credibility with operators and supervisors, and model the Gemba-first, data-driven culture the IE team stands for. Communicate IE impact to senior leadership with clarity and conviction.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, Operations Research, or a related field.
* 12+ years of experience in industrial engineering, manufacturing engineering, or production operations, with demonstrated depth across multiple IE disciplines (labor standards, layout design, capacity planning, simulation).
* 5+ years managing industrial engineers or manufacturing engineers, including experience managing managers or leads — with demonstrated hiring, org design, and team-building experience.
* Experience building or scaling an IE team in a ramp or start-up production environment — designing team structure, hiring into it, and standing up capabilities from early stages.
* Deep technical credibility in core IE fundamentals: time studies, labor standards (MTM/MODAPTS), line balancing, layout design, capacity planning, and production system design.
* Experience operating as a peer of production leadership — influencing strategy, owning budgets and headcount, and communicating IE impact to VP-level audiences.
* Track record of driving measurable operational improvement — IE initiatives that moved production metrics and can be quantified.
* Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations Research, MBA, or a related field.
* Experience in defense, aerospace, or other highly regulated, high-mix manufacturing environments with complex compliance and traceability requirements.
* Experience standing up a centralized or embedded IE function from scratch — methodology selection, standards development, tooling, and organizational adoption.
* Proficiency in simulation software (FlexSim, Arena, AnyLogic, or equivalent), data analytics/visualization (Power BI, Tableau), or experience integrating IE deliverables with MES/ERP platforms.
* Experience designing and commissioning new production lines or manufacturing facilities.
* Active security clearance, or ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
  + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
  + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

### **Data Privacy**

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

  

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. The Senior Manager, LCML Fulfillment Operations leads the end-to-end order fulfillment and distribution execution operating model for Carrier's Light Commercial (LCML) HVAC business within Climate Solutions Americas (CSA). Reporting to CSA Logistics & Supply Chain leadership, this role balances customer service reliability, on-time in-full (OTIF) delivery performance, inventory allocation governance, and fulfillment cost-to-serve productivity across North America.

This leader directs a team of fulfillment operations planners, order management specialists, and execution coordinators, steering initiatives in order backlog reduction, multi-site distribution throughput, order consolidation, and peak seasonal readiness. Working collaboratively with Light Commercial SIOP, Manufacturing Operations, Distribution Center (DC) Operations, Transportation, and Commercial Sales leadership, the Senior Manager establishes fulfillment KPIs and SLAs, enhances ERP/WMS/TMS data integrity, and champions continuous improvement across the order-to-delivery ecosystem.

* **Order Backlog & SLA Performance Management:** Own fulfillment scorecard reviews, OTIF delivery metrics, order-to-ship cycle times, and aged backlog governance. Partner with DC Operations and Transportation to optimize fulfillment capacity and SLA compliance.
* **Exception Management & Disruption Recovery:** Lead proactive operational recovery for critical customer delivery delays, inventory allocation constraints, capacity crunches, and seasonal demand surges.
* **Cross-Functional Alignment:** Partner strategically with Light Commercial SIOP, Manufacturing Plants, Customer Service, and Commercial Sales leadership to align inventory positioning, product launch (NPI) fulfillment readiness, and customer lead-time commitments.

existing_roles.title: General Manager, Data Operations
existing_roles.description:
**About David AI**
------------------

At David AI, our vision is to bring impactful AI into billions of lives through voice. Our mission is to help the world's leading AI companies build better voice models and agents. We're building the data and evaluation infrastructure behind those models.

Founded in 2024, we're a fast-growing Series B company backed by NVIDIA, Meritech, First Round, YC, and others, with ~70 people across San Francisco and New York City.

**About our Data Operations team**
----------------------------------

Our Data Operations team powers David AI's Data Factory, transforming raw audio into high-quality training datasets for leading AI labs. Our mandate is to spin up new data pipelines and run them at a massive scale.

This means starting from a model capability we want a model to unlock, experimenting with different shapes of data and collection strategies, and validating them with researchers. Once an approach works, we industrialize it, building pipelines that can process audio with reliability, quality, and efficiency. We are relentless operators who thrive in ambiguity, equally comfortable prototyping novel workflows as we are managing large-scale production systems.

**About this role**
-------------------

As **General Manager of Data Operations** at David AI, you will lead one of the most critical functions at David AI. You’ll own a major slice of our Data Factory: the engine that powers high-quality, scalable data production. You’ll lead the team responsible for building and scaling pipelines, from 0 1 experiments that unlock new model capabilities to 1 N industrialization that processes data reliably and efficiently.

**In this role, you will**
--------------------------

* Build and lead a team of Data Product Operations Leads, to spin up and scale data pipelines, from early experiments to production systems that generate high-quality audio data at scale.
* Act as a thought partner to executive leadership on how we can evolve and scale delivery capabilities in service of customer needs.
* Continuously monitor and improve pipeline health, spotting issues in sourcing, quality, or process early and owning solutions end-to-end.
* Use metrics to drive decisions, tracking throughput, quality, and cost to guide prioritization and identify where to scale or invest next.
* Work with researchers at leading AI labs to identify new model capabilities and turn them into concrete data workflows and project plans.
* Partner with our internal research team to design and test new data shapes that unlock frontier model capabilities.
* Own outcomes across functions, designing systems, managing execution, unblocking bottlenecks, and ensuring delivery at both prototype and production scale.

**Your background looks like**
------------------------------

* 5 to 10+ years of experience in high-ownership roles (e.g., founder, GM, COO, or strategy/ops at a venture-backed startup).
* Prior experience scaling large-scale operational efforts at high-growth startups or fast-paced companies.
* Technical fluency with data and operations; SQL proficiency required.
* Prior experience designing and scaling systems, processes, and teams across different customer segments and product lines.
* A relentless operator with high standards, bias to action, and strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid pace; thrives in a “build while flying” environment.
* Low-ego, collaborative, and mission-driven, focused on team and company success.

**Bonus points if you have**
----------------------------

* Experience in data, ML, or large-scale operations.
* Background in CS, industrial engineering, or similar.

**Benefits**
------------

* Unlimited PTO.
* Top-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans.
* FSA & HSA access.
* 401k access.
* Meals 2x daily through DoorDash + snacks and beverages available at the office.
* Unlimited company-sponsored Barry's classes.

**Visas**
---------

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B *transfers*, H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

Compensation Range: $205K - $235K

existing_roles.title: General Manager - Wastewater Operations
existing_roles.description:
**Are You a Wastewater Expert Who Knows How to Build a Business?**

We are looking for a dynamic, entrepreneurial, results-driven **General Manager – Wastewater Operations** to lead, grow, and transform our **Eastern United States Region.**

This is not a traditional operations management position. This is an opportunity for a proven wastewater leader and business-minded entrepreneur to take ownership of a region, build high-performing teams, strengthen customer partnerships, drive profitable growth, and establish a standard of operational excellence.

At Solution Group, we deliver specialized wastewater treatment solutions, chemical program management, and operational expertise to some of the most demanding industrial environments in the country, including dairy processing, rendering, and food and beverage manufacturing.

Our customers depend on us to solve complex wastewater challenges, maintain regulatory compliance, improve treatment performance, and reduce operating costs. We need a leader who understands these challenges firsthand and has the technical credibility, business acumen, and leadership presence to take our regional operations to the next level.

**We are looking for a leader who thinks like an owner, operates like an expert, and leads like an entrepreneur.**

**THE OPPORTUNITY: OWN IT. GROW IT. LEAD IT.**

As General Manager, you will have full accountability for the performance and growth of your assigned region. You will lead a multi-site wastewater operation with accountability for financial performance, customer relationships, business development, operational execution, safety, and talent development.

You will have the autonomy and accountability to make an impact, identify opportunities, challenge the status quo, and build a stronger, more profitable business.

Your mission is to create a high-performing regional organization that consistently delivers exceptional wastewater treatment results, outstanding customer experiences, strong financial performance, and a culture of accountability.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

**1. Business Growth & Entrepreneurial Leadership**

* Take ownership of regional growth, identifying new customers, developing market opportunities, and expanding our presence within existing accounts.
* Build executive-level customer relationships that create trust, strengthen retention, and generate new business.
* Identify opportunities to introduce additional services, technologies, and revenue streams across existing customer locations.
* Partner with Business Development, Key Account Managers, and Technical Services to win new business and successfully launch new customer operations.
* Explore strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and opportunities to expand our regional footprint.
* Develop and execute a regional growth strategy with measurable revenue and profitability targets.

**2. Full P&L Ownership & Financial Performance**

* Own the financial performance of the region, including revenue, EBITDA, labor, chemicals, materials, maintenance, and capital expenditures.
* Drive profitable growth through disciplined financial management, cost optimization, and operational accountability.
* Establish clear financial expectations and performance metrics throughout the organization.
* Develop accurate forecasts, budgets, and action plans to improve business performance.
* Communicate financial results, opportunities, challenges, and corrective actions to executive leadership.

**3. Wastewater Expertise & Operational Excellence**

* Provide strategic and technical leadership across a portfolio of industrial wastewater treatment operations.
* Leverage your deep wastewater knowledge to improve treatment performance, process stability, compliance, and operating efficiency.
* Establish consistent operating standards, SOPs, preventive maintenance programs, and performance metrics across all locations.
* Drive standardization and best-practice implementation while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
* Lead troubleshooting and problem-solving efforts on complex wastewater treatment challenges.
* Champion continuous improvement, root cause analysis, process optimization, and operational discipline.

**4. Customer Leadership & Retention**

* Own the overall customer experience and build long-term, trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders.
* Maintain a strong customer retention rate through proactive engagement, exceptional service delivery, and measurable results.
* Lead strategic customer business reviews and identify opportunities to deliver additional value.
* Partner with Key Account Managers to ensure customer expectations are consistently met and exceeded.
* Position Solution Group as a strategic wastewater partner, not simply a service provider.

**5. Safety, Compliance & Operational Discipline**

* Establish a culture where safety, environmental compliance, and operational excellence are non-negotiable.
* Partner with HSE leadership to drive safety performance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure all locations maintain strong environmental compliance, documentation, training, and preventative safety practices.
* Champion 5S, workplace organization, and consistent execution of operational standards.
* Lead with visibility, accountability, and a commitment to ensuring every employee goes home safely.

**6. Build, Develop & Inspire High-Performing Teams**

* Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional operational leaders and wastewater professionals.
* Lead and coach Key Account Managers, Regional Managers, and Site Managers.
* Establish clear expectations, performance goals, and accountability throughout the region.
* Develop succession plans and create opportunities for employees to grow into greater leadership responsibilities.
* Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and results.
* Lead by example and inspire teams to take pride in their work, their customers, and their performance.

**7. Enterprise Leadership & Collaboration**

* Work closely with other General Managers and corporate leadership to share best practices and drive company-wide success.
* Collaborate with Technical Services, Business Development, Sales, HR, Finance, and HSE to strengthen capabilities and execute strategic initiatives.
* Contribute to the long-term growth, scalability, and success of Solution Group.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a strong, confident, entrepreneurial leader who brings together deep technical wastewater expertise, proven operational leadership, and a genuine passion for building a business.

**You are someone who:**

* Knows wastewater treatment. You understand industrial wastewater processes, treatment systems, troubleshooting, chemistry, compliance, and the operational challenges our customers face.
* Thinks like a business owner. You understand P&L performance, revenue growth, cost control, and what it takes to build a profitable operation.
* Is commercially driven. You naturally identify opportunities, build relationships, grow accounts, and turn customer challenges into business opportunities.
* Leads with confidence. You know how to build trust, set expectations, develop people, and hold teams accountable.
* Is operationally disciplined. You believe in KPIs, standardization, preventative maintenance, continuous improvement, and measurable results.
* Is entrepreneurial. You are energized by growth, change, new opportunities, and the ability to make a meaningful impact.
* Is a problem solver. You are comfortable navigating complex operational challenges and making decisions in a fast-paced environment.
* Is collaborative. You understand that regional success contributes to company-wide success.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS**

* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in industrial wastewater treatment, environmental services, industrial services, utilities, or related operational environments.
* Demonstrated expertise in industrial wastewater treatment operations, including treatment processes, troubleshooting, environmental compliance, and emerging technologies.
* Proven experience leading multi-site or regional operations with direct leadership responsibility for multiple levels of management.
* Previous full P&L ownership with demonstrated success improving profitability and financial performance.
* A track record of growing revenue, expanding customer relationships, and developing new business opportunities.
* Experience building and implementing operational standards, KPIs, SOPs, audit programs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and accountability.
* Experience with Lean, TPM, 5S, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, customer relationship, and change management skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel 50% or more throughout the Eastern US Region.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Business, Operations, or a related discipline.
* State-issued wastewater operator license (Class A, B, C, or D, as applicable).
* Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement certifications.
* Experience with mergers, acquisitions, and business integration.

**WHY SOLUTION GROUP?**

At Solution Group, you won't simply inherit a job description and maintain the status quo. You will have the opportunity to influence the direction of a growing business, develop exceptional teams, strengthen customer partnerships, and make a measurable impact on our future.

We offer:

* **Executive-Level Compensation:** $140,000–$200,000 base salary, plus eligibility for an annual performance bonus.
* **Meaningful Leadership:** Full regional ownership and the opportunity to directly influence business performance and strategy.
* **Entrepreneurial Opportunity:** The ability to identify opportunities, drive growth, and help shape the future of the organization.
* **Strong Team Environment:** Work alongside experienced wastewater professionals and collaborative corporate leadership.
* **Competitive Benefits:** Health, dental, vision, 401k, Paid Time Off.
* **Professional Development:** Continued technical training and opportunities for career advancement.
* **Travel Reimbursement:** Mileage reimbursement for business travel.

**THE BOTTOM LINE**

**We are looking for a wastewater expert who is ready to lead a business, not just manage operations.**

If you have the technical depth to understand complex wastewater challenges, the business acumen to drive profitable growth, and the leadership ability to build exceptional teams, we want to hear from you.

**Come build something great with Solution Group.**

*Solution Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected status under applicable federal, state, or local laws.*

existing_roles.description:
### **YOUR MISSION**

Make Nulogy's Product and Engineering organization run like a well-oiled machine, and make sure the rest of the company can see, trust, and act on what it builds. As a member of the Product Leadership Team, you will own the operating system behind how we plan, deliver, measure, and launch product. You will connect the voice of our customers and go-to-market teams to the roadmap, give leadership clear visibility into delivery and outcomes, and ensure every release lands with customers and colleagues who know exactly what changed and why it matters.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Keep the trains running on time across Product and Engineering.** Build and run an effective operating rhythm, including planning, roadmap reviews, and delivery check-ins, with one trusted view of every initiative's timeline, dependencies, and risks.
* **Raise delivery predictability.** Support and coach Product Managers and Engineering Managers to plan realistically, spot delivery risk early, and act on it.
* **Close the loop between go-to-market and Product.** Maintain a living log of product needs from new-logo and existing-customer opportunities, tied to pipeline and ARR, and track friction points across the customer lifecycle with Customer Success and Professional Services.
* **Put the right data behind product decisions.** Centralize data from our product, delivery, customer, and revenue systems so PMs and leaders can answer key questions without hunting for numbers.
* **Build trust through KPIs, reporting, and transparency.** Define core product and delivery KPIs with the Product Leadership Team, and own the dashboards and reporting that feed executive, board, and all-hands updates.
* **Align the organization around what we're building.** Make sure Product and Engineering plans are understood across GTM, Customer Success, Services, Finance, and leadership, and that every release lands through release notes, customer communications, and internal enablement.
* **Be present with customers.** Join customer visits, calls, and reviews, and bring what you hear back into planning.
* **Be a right hand to the CPO.** Drive the day-to-day of the product organization, prepare executive communication briefs, and lead special projects as they come up.

**EXPERIENCE & SKILL REQUIREMENTS**

* 8+ years in product operations, program or delivery management, product management, business operations, or a chief-of-staff-style role at a B2B SaaS company, including 3+ years working across Product and Engineering.
* A track record of running an operating rhythm and tracking delivery across multiple product and engineering teams, including coaching teams to improve predictability.
* Hands-on experience centralizing data from multiple systems into a single view
* Experience building KPIs and reporting that executives relied on for decisions.
* Strong executive communication: you've written leadership briefs, executive updates, or board materials.
* Comfortable working directly with customers, including on-site visits.
* Experience as a trusted partner to a senior leader, owning day-to-day operations and special projects.
* Exceptional attention to detail and follow-through.
* AI-first operating habits: you use AI tools daily in your own work.
* Able to travel as needed for customer visits and team offsites approximately 1-2x a quarter
* Experience in enterprise SaaS serving supply chain, manufacturing, or logistics.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as Jira and Confluence, Pendo, Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience running release communications or launch programs for customers and internal teams.
* Experience measuring product adoption and usage.
* A background as a Product Manager, Engineering Manager, Program Manager, or Chief of Staff to a product or engineering leader.

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**  
  
Nulogy is a manufacturing technology company driven by a vision to make life better for the people who plan, produce, and deliver the products we use every day.  
Nulogy’s Manufacturing Operating System helps manufacturers and packagers automate every stage of the production process—from inventory to quality—which reduces operating costs, increases efficiency, and boosts customer satisfaction. Hundreds of manufacturing sites around the world are powered by Nulogy, and our software also runs in the networks of world-leading brands such as Colgate-Palmolive, L’Oréal, and Procter & Gamble.  
  
Nulogy has grown rapidly over the last decade, and we are proud to be recognized with a number of awards including: Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers, Food Logistics Top 100 Software Provider, and Canada's Most Admired Corporate Culture. Nulogy has also received multiple awards for company culture, the most recent being one of Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers for 2024, Great Place to Work 2025 & Greater Toronto’s Top Employers for 2025.  
  
By joining Nulogy, you’ll become part of a fantastic culture of capable and motivated individuals. You’ll also join a team that is solving challenging problems every day with the potential to make a global impact.  
  
**OUR VALUES**  
**1. We put people first**  
We lead with genuine care, build strong relationships, and create space for people to grow.  
**2. We rewrite the playbook**  
We don’t wait for perfect conditions. We move, deliver, and refine, solving problems creatively as we go.  
**3. We learn up**  
We stay curious, learn from the people and experiences around us, and keep looking ahead.  
**4. We take the hot potato!**  
When something goes wrong, we don’t pass the problem along. We take ownership and work together to solve it.  
**5. We ring the bell together**  
We celebrate success as a team and recognize the people who helped make it happen.  
  
**WHY NULOGY**  
We’re solving problems that no one has been able to solve before. This is an opportunity to join a team that is transforming the way that supply chains are structured.  
  
Competitive benefits package: Group benefit plans including health, dental, and vision that start on day one—benefit premiums are fully paid by the employer; Parental leave: 100% top-up for 15 weeks for any parent of biological or adopted children; Flexible paid vacation policy; RRSP Matching Program, 401K program.  
  
**FULLY REMOTE**  
Everyone is set up with the tools and resources required to stay connected and help employees do their best work.  
  
*Nulogy embraces diversity, and we recognize the need for teams that represent a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We encourage everyone to apply.*

protected_roles.title: Director of Quality and Compliance
protected_roles.description:
Founded in 1982 as Joliet Area Community Hospice, Lightways Hospice and Serious Illness Care is an independent, nonprofit healthcare provider licensed in 11 counties in northwest Illinois. We provide exceptional serious illness care, hospice care and grief support for adults and children.

The majority of our direct patient care is in the field with Lightways team members providing care in the home, nursing facility or assisted living facility. We also have a 24-bed inpatient unit in Joliet. Non-clinical staff are based out of our Joliet administrative offices.

**Director of Quality and Compliance**

The Director of Quality & Compliance provides administrative oversight for Quality, Compliance, Medical Records, and Risk Management functions, while also serving as the organization’s designated Compliance Officer.

This role delivers strategic and operational leadership for the Lightways Quality Assessment & Performance Improvement (QAPI) program, regulatory compliance, accreditation readiness, clinical education, and risk management. The Director is responsible for developing, implementing, and evaluating robust systems that promote safety, regulatory adherence, and high-quality care across all organizational operations.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Reference, research, report, track, and monitor compliance and quality-related data.
* Develop, implement, and evaluate strategies for quality assurance, performance improvement, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
* Create and maintain the organization’s annual Quality and Compliance Plans and Reports.
* Lead quarterly Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAPI) meetings.
* Review Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (CAHPS) survey data, complaints, and incident reports to inform improvement strategies.
* Develop and deliver education, policies, and process improvements to promote accurate, timely, and compliant clinical documentation across the organization.

  

**Education/Experience:**

* Master's degree in healthcare or related field (required)
* Management experience with hospice and/or palliative care experience preferred.
* Certification in a specialist area preferred; (e.g. Hospice and Palliative Nursing (CHPN), Pediatrics or Geriatrics)

  

**Benefits:**

* 401(k) matching
* Health Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Personal Time Off
* Holiday Paid

protected_roles.title: Quality Director
protected_roles.description:
**Summary**

Provides strategic leadership and direction for the Quality organization, ensuring that quality systems, processes, and practices support business objectives, customer requirements, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence. Establishes quality strategy, policies, objectives, and performance expectations and provides leadership across functions to drive continuous improvement, strengthen quality performance, mitigate risk, and support business growth.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic leadership and direction for the Quality organization, establishing priorities, objectives, and performance expectations aligned with business and operational goals.
* Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the site's Quality Management System and associated quality policies, procedures, and controls.
* Serve as the site's senior quality leader and management representative for applicable ISO 9001, AS9100, and ISO 13485 quality management systems.
* Ensure continued compliance with applicable regulatory, customer, industry, and certification requirements, including applicable FDA, ITAR, ISO, and IPC requirements and standards.
* Provide leadership for quality planning related to processes, products, customers, and business requirements, with consideration for broader corporate quality objectives.
* Establish and monitor quality metrics and performance indicators. Identify trends, risks, and systemic issues and lead actions to improve quality performance.
* Provide quality performance, risk, and improvement recommendations to site and organizational leadership.
* Lead the Material Review Board (MRB) process and provide oversight for the disposition and control of nonconforming material and product.
* Provide leadership and oversight for corrective and preventive actions, root cause analysis, and systemic problem resolution in partnership with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and other functions.
* Lead quality improvement initiatives focused on reducing defects, improving process capability, increasing throughput, and strengthening overall operational performance.
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality ownership throughout the organization.
* Provide oversight of internal and external audit activities, certification requirements, customer audits, and resulting corrective actions.
* Partner with Supply Chain and suppliers to evaluate supplier quality performance, address quality risks, and ensure supplier quality systems meet business and customer requirements.
* Oversee the calibration system and applicable preventive maintenance controls to ensure compliance and effectiveness.
* Ensure appropriate training and organizational capability related to workmanship standards, acceptance criteria, quality systems, and regulatory/customer requirements.
* Support environmental management requirements, including applicable ISO 14001 responsibilities and site environmental management activities.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, and other functions to identify and mitigate quality and operational risks and improve customer outcomes.
* Provide quality leadership and expertise in support of new products, customers, programs, processes, and business opportunities.
* Promote awareness and understanding of regulatory, customer, and quality requirements throughout the organization.
* Lead, develop, and mentor Quality leaders and team members, building organizational capability and ensuring appropriate talent development and succession planning.
* Support corporate and site Lean/6S objectives and integrate quality principles into continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support and follow all applicable Quality Management System requirements related to quality, environmental, health, safety, and security.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Job Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Advanced knowledge of quality management systems and quality principles within a complex manufacturing environment.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 9001, AS9100, ISO 13485, and other applicable regulatory and customer quality requirements.
* Working knowledge of FDA, ITAR, IPC, and applicable electronics manufacturing standards and requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into quality strategies, priorities, metrics, and improvement initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of corrective action, root cause analysis, risk management, process improvement, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Ability to analyze quality and operational data, identify trends and systemic risks, and develop effective corrective and preventive strategies.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to balance quality, customer, operational, financial, and business considerations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence decisions and drive results across functions without relying solely on direct authority.
* Strong leadership and organizational capability, including experience building, developing, and leading professional and technical teams.
* Ability to communicate effectively with customers, regulatory bodies, auditors, suppliers, and senior leadership.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and applicable electronic manufacturing and quality systems.

**Experience/Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Operations, or a related technical discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible quality, engineering, or manufacturing experience, including significant leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated experience leading a quality organization within a complex manufacturing environment.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent technical, quality, and operational priorities.
* Demonstrated experience influencing cross-functional leaders and driving organization-wide quality and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience interacting with customers, auditors, regulatory organizations, and senior business leadership.
* Demonstrated balance of strategic thinking, strong analytical capability, and effective execution.
* Strong business judgment, attention to detail, and written and verbal communication skills.

**Due to ITAR and / or CUI compliance, this position requires candidates to be a U.S. Citizen.**

Benefits Offered: Comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental and vision coverage; company-paid basic life/AD&D insurance, short-term and long-term disability insurance; voluntary supplemental insurances, flexible spending accounts and employee assistance program (EAP). Sick Leave, Vacation Time, and company-paid Holidays are also provided as paid time off. NEOTech also provides a 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan option with a company match.

NEOTech is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

NEOTech has a long-standing commitment to maintaining a safe, quality-oriented and productive work environment. We also want all employees to perform their duties safely and efficiently, in a manner that protects their interests and those of their co-workers. We recognize that alcohol and drug abuse pose a threat to the health and safety of NEOTech employees and to the security of the Company’s equipment and facilities. For these reasons, NEOTech is committed to the elimination of drug and alcohol use and abuse in the workplace. Candidates being considered for hire must pass a pre-employment background check and drug test which include screening for illegal drugs and marijuana.

Shirley Ryan AbilityLab is the global leader in physical medicine and rehabilitation for adults and children with the most severe, complex conditions. By joining our team, you’ll be part of our life-changing mission and vision. You’ll contribute to an innovative, multifaceted culture that is second to none — one that embraces collaboration, excellence, discovery and compassion. You’ll play a role in something that’s never been done before as we integrate science and clinical care to help patients achieve better, faster outcomes — as we Advance Human Ability, together.

**Job Description Summary**

The Director, Quality Improvement provides strategic leadership, oversight, and operational direction for quality improvement, regulatory readiness, accreditation compliance, and performance improvement initiatives across the Shirley Ryan AbilityLab system of care, inclusive of the Alliances. This role partners closely with clinical, operational, and administrative leaders to foster a culture of continuous improvement, patient safety, accountability, and high reliability in alignment with organizational goals and Envision 2030 priorities.  
  
The Director leads enterprise quality improvement initiatives, coordinates accreditation and regulatory readiness activities, advances data-informed decision-making, and supports ongoing compliance with applicable standards and requirements, including CARF, The Joint Commission, CMS, and other regulatory bodies. The Director serves as a key advisor and partner to clinical, operational, and administrative leaders to advance quality outcomes, patient safety, operational effectiveness, and organizational excellence.

**Job Description**

**The Director, Quality Improvement will:**

  

* Provide leadership and direction for quality improvement, performance improvement, accreditation, and regulatory readiness programs across the Shirley Ryan AbilityLab system of care, with initial focus at the flagship hospital
* Develop and lead quality and performance improvement initiatives utilizing evidence-based methodologies and frameworks to advance regulatory compliance, patient outcomes, and operational excellence across the Shirley Ryan AbilityLab system of care, with initial focus at the flagship hospital.
* Partner with leaders to align quality initiatives with strategic organizational priorities and Envision 2030 goals.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, transparency, accountability, and interdisciplinary collaboration.
* Oversee the identification, development, tracking, analysis, and reporting of key quality, patient safety, operational, and regulatory performance measures. Identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with leaders and teams to identify opportunities for improvement and implement sustainable corrective action plans.
* Lead the annual development, evaluation, and update of the organization's Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement (QAPI) Plan and support ongoing monitoring of organizational performance against established priorities.
* Support departments in developing measurable goals, dashboards, and improvement plans to drive organizational performance.
* Direct organizational accreditation and regulatory readiness efforts, including preparation for CARF, The Joint Commission, CMS, and other applicable surveys and reviews.
* Maintain knowledge of evolving regulatory and accreditation standards and assess and communicate organizational impacts, risks, and recommended actions to leadership.
* Partner with operational and clinical leaders to ensure policies, procedures, workflows, and practices align with regulatory requirements and best practices.
* Oversee regulatory and accreditation survey response activities, corrective action plans, and ongoing monitoring to ensure timely and sustained compliance.
* Oversee the development and presentation of quality and performance reports, dashboards, and executive-level analyses to support organizational decision-making.
* Oversee the development and presentation of quality and performance reports, dashboards, and executive-level analyses that provide meaningful insights, support organizational accountability, and inform leadership decision-making.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and resource for quality improvement, accreditation, regulatory readiness, and performance improvement methodologies.
* Partner with leaders, physicians, clinicians, and operational teams to build organizational capability and accountability for quality, patient safety, and performance improvement.
* Develop and facilitate training, education, and communication strategies related to accreditation standards, regulatory requirements, and quality initiatives.
* Represent Quality and Safety on organizational committees, councils, and interdisciplinary teams as assigned.
* Perform all other duties that may be assigned in the best interest of the Shirley Ryan AbilityLab.

**Reporting Relationships**

* Reports directly to the Executive Director, Quality and Safety.
* Provides leadership and oversight to assigned quality, accreditation, regulatory, and performance improvement staff.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Required**

* Master's degree in healthcare administration, business administration, public health, nursing, allied health or a related healthcare field required.
* Minimum of seven years of progressively responsible experience in healthcare quality improvement, accreditation, regulatory compliance, patient safety, or performance improvement, within a hospital, rehabilitation, or complex healthcare environment. .
* Relevant quality, patient safety, accreditation, or healthcare certification (e.g., CPHQ, CPPS) is required or obtained within two years of hire.
* Comprehensive knowledge of healthcare quality and performance improvement methodologies, accreditation standards, and regulatory requirements, with demonstrated experience leading accreditation and regulatory readiness activities. Knowledge of CARF, The Joint Commission, CMS, and other applicable healthcare regulatory and accreditation requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to interpret complex quality, patient safety, operational and regulatory data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Exceptional communication, facilitation, and relationship-building skills, with demonstrated ability to collaborate with and influence physicians, clinical leaders, operational leaders, and other stakeholders across all levels of the organization.
* Demonstrated project and change management capabilities, including the ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from planning thru implementation and sustained adoption.

**Working Conditions**

* Normal office environment with little or no exposure to dust or extreme temperature undefined

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.

We are AS9100 and ISO9001-registered facility. For over 40 years, we’ve built a culture of stability and growth—now we are looking for passionate individuals to join our team and grow with us.

  

**WHY JOIN US?**

At our core, quality is about more than compliance—it's about safely putting people in the air. This is a unique opportunity for a results-driven leader to challenge the status quo, drive measurable improvements and build organizational capability. If you are passionate about continuous improvement, operational excellence, and leading meaningful change, you'll play a critical role in strengthening customer confidence, improving business performance, and shaping the next chapter of our growth.

  

**Summary**

Reporting to the Vice President, Quality, the incumbent will lead the company's quality strategy, systems, and culture. Responsible for ensuring product quality, regulatory compliance, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement. Responsible for leadership for quality professionals.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute the company's quality vision, strategy, and performance objectives.
* Lead Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Supplier Quality, and Continuous Improvement.
* Maintain compliance with customer, regulatory, and industry quality standards, including AS9100.
* Drive customer satisfaction through proactive quality management, problem resolution, and performance improvement.
* Champion root cause analysis, corrective actions, risk mitigation, and defect prevention.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams to improve operational excellence and business performance.
* Lead customer audits, internal audits for site and division, management reviews, and quality system assessments.
* Build, develop, and mentor a high-performing quality organization.

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive quality leadership experience in aerospace, automotive, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated success developing and leading certified quality management systems and customer-focused quality initiatives.
* Strong leadership, communication, change management, and customer relationship skills.
* Proven record of driving measurable improvements in quality, delivery, cost, and operational performance.
* Broad experience that includes start-up, multi-site, acquisitions and significant business transformation.

  

**Required Skills**

* Strong leadership, communication, change management, and customer relationship skills.
* Proven record of driving measurable improvements in quality, delivery, cost, and operational performance.
* Experience developing and leading certified quality management systems and customer-focused quality initiatives.

  

**Preferred Skills**

* Certifications such as Lead Auditor and completion of Quality Training
* Broad experience that includes start-up, multi-site and significant business transformation.

  

**Compensation**

Candidates selected for conversation about this opportunity will be provided more information during the screening and interviewing phase.

  

**Other**

* This position does not provide Sponsorship, now or in the future.
* This position is on-site; no opportunity to work remote.
* The company is seeking candidates that can be immediately available.

protected_roles.title: Director of Compliance, Quality & Risk
protected_roles.description:
POSITION SUMMARY
  
  
Will provide strategic leadership, direction, and oversight of the Laguna Healthcare Corporation (LHC) Compliance, Quality Risk Programs, encompassing all clinical, administrative, financial, and medical practice plan functions. This position is responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving enterprise-wide programs that ensure adherence to all federal, state, tribal, and accreditation standards. Serve as the primary authority on compliance matters, leads risk mitigation efforts, manages investigations, and champions a culture of ethics, accountability, and transparency. The Director collaborates with leadership, providers, and staff to promote a culture of continuous improvement, patient safety, and accountability. They oversee performance improvement initiatives, incident reporting systems, compliance activities, and risk mitigation strategies to enhance patient outcomes and organizational effectiveness. This position also plays a critical role in integrating culturally responsive care into quality frameworks, supporting health equity, and ensuring services reflect the values, traditions, and needs of the Tribal population served.
  
  
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  
  

* Develop, implement, and oversee LHC’s Compliance, Quality Risk programs, policies, and procedures related to standards of conduct; healthcare laws; billing and reimbursement; fraud, waste, and abuse prevention; privacy and security; quality improvement and other compliance risk areas.
* Lead and facilitate internal committees to drive strategic planning for these programs, setting long- and short-term goals, operational plans, and performance measures.
* Conduct organization-wide quality and risk assessments to identify, prioritize, and mitigate compliance risks and improve overall patient outcomes.
* Monitor compliance with healthcare laws, CMS/OIG regulations, HIPAA/HITECH, and Tribal requirements.
* Oversee sanction screening of employees, contractors, and vendors; ensure organization-wide training on sanction monitoring processes. Ensure credentialing, privileging and provider enrollment program is effective.
* Lead internal audits and compliance reviews to ensure adherence to payer rules, regulatory standards, and organizational policies.
* Develop, in collaboration with the CMO, clinical care guidelines, as well as process and system guidelines.
* Manage confidential reporting channels, including the LHC Compliance Hotline, ensuring proper documentation, investigation, and resolution.
* Conduct or supervise compliance investigations; ensure/coordinate corrective actions with HR, legal counsel, leadership, and managers.
* Serve as the organizational liaison with regulatory agencies during audits, investigations, and compliance inquiries.
* Lead and mentor others in root cause analysis (RCA), healthcare failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) and hazard vulnerability analysis (HVA) teams. Summarize risk management and patient safety data for appropriate evaluation and risk trend analysis.
* Maintain detailed records of compliance efforts, investigative outcomes, and corrective action plans.
* Provide written and verbal compliance reports to executive management, internal Quality Committee, the Board Compliance Committee and the LHC Board of Directors.
* Develop and administer a robust, organization-wide compliance training and education program in conjunction managers and the HR department.
* Lead communication initiatives to promote compliance awareness, ethical conduct, quality management and transparent reporting.
* Provide ongoing consultation to staff and leadership on regulatory requirements and performance improvement measures.
* Develop and coordinate processes to monitor quality of care. Identify opportunities to improve patient care, treatment and services by assisting to implement standard work.
* Oversee accreditation preparation for review by regulatory agencies including AAAHC and/or Joint Commission, educate, and assist department supervisors to maintain appropriate policies and procedures to fulfill requirements and regulations.
* Develop, monitor, and manage department budget.
* Supervise and direct staff and consultants and ensure adequate systems, training and tools to support program goals achievement, performance management and corrective action.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  
  
Five (5) years of progressive experience in healthcare compliance, quality or related healthcare roles. Bachelor Degree in Finance/Accounting, Business, Public or Healthcare Administration or related field of study from an accredited college or university. Master's Degree preferred.
  
  
Certified Professional Compliance Officer (CPCO) preferred, Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC), Certified in Healthcare Privacy Compliance (CHPC), or Certified Compliance Ethics Professional (CCEP) or equivalent compliance certification, or eligible for and certification obtained within 12 months as condition of hire. Quality Management certification preferred.
  
  
MANDATORY KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES and COMPETENCIES with proficiency levels
  
  
Ethical Integrity Professionalism — Advanced
  
  
1. Demonstrates unwavering commitment to confidentiality, transparency, and ethical conduct.
  
  
2. Consistently models organizational values and establishes an ethical compliance culture.
  
  
3. Guides organizational decision-making through an ethics-centered approach.
  
  
Regulatory Compliance Expertise — Advanced
  
  
1. Interprets and applies federal, state, and Tribal healthcare regulations with precision.
  
  
2. Advises leadership on complex regulatory issues and emerging compliance risks.
  
  
3. Ensures organizational alignment with OIG, CMS, HIPAA/HITECH, and other regulatory standards.
  
  
Analytical Critical Thinking — Advanced
  
  
1. Uses advanced analytical methods to identify trends, risks, and system vulnerabilities.
  
  
2. Evaluates complex scenarios, synthesizes large volumes of information, and provides clear recommendations.
  
  
3. Leads continuous improvement initiatives using data-driven insights.
  
  
Investigation Problem-Solving — Advanced
  
  

* Conducts or oversees thorough investigations into compliance concerns.
* Demonstrates strong evidence analysis skills and draws objective, well-supported conclusions.
* Designs and monitors corrective action plans to ensure sustainable resolution

Leadership Influence — Advanced
  
  
1. Leads cross-functional teams and committees with confidence and clarity.
  
  
2. Influences organizational behavior through effective communication, coaching, and ethical leadership.
  
  
3. Builds trust and credibility with executives, clinical leaders, and staff.
  
  
Communication Interpersonal Effectiveness — Advanced
  
  
1. Clearly communicates complex regulatory concepts to varied audiences.
  
  
2. Prepares high-quality written reports and delivers professional presentations.
  
  
3. Maintains strong interpersonal relationships across diverse stakeholder groups.
  
  
Training Education Development — Intermediate to Advanced
  
  
1. Designs tailored compliance training programs for all workforce levels.
  
  
2. Assesses training effectiveness and adjusts content to address knowledge gaps.
  
  
3. Promotes consistent awareness of compliance responsibilities.
  
  
Project Program Management — Intermediate to Advanced
  
  
1. Manages multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
  
  
2. Develops strategic and operational plans for the Compliance Program.
  
  
3. Implements structured processes for tracking progress and outcomes.
  
  
Risk Management Continuous Improvement — Advanced
  
  
1. Conducts comprehensive risk assessments and ongoing monitoring activities.
  
  
2. Identifies compliance vulnerabilities and implements preventative strategies.
  
  
3. Leads continuous improvement efforts across systems, policies, and internal controls.
  
  
Technical Systems Proficiency — Intermediate
  
  
1. Utilizes compliance software, databases, and Microsoft Office applications effectively.
  
  
2. Works collaboratively with IT and privacy teams to support data security practices.
  
  
3. Applies technology solutions to enhance documentation, reporting, and workflow efficiency.
  
  
PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS
  
  
In performance of their respective tasks and duties, an employee of Laguna Healthcare Corporation is expected to conform to the following:
  
  
1. Fully uphold all principles of confidentiality and patient care.
  
  
2. Adhere to all professional and ethical behavior standards of the healthcare industry.
  
  
3. Maintain all licensures and certifications required of position.
  
  
4. Interact in an honest, trustworthy and respectful manner with patients, employees, visitors and vendors.
  
  
5. Participate in leadership and/or board meetings, departmental staff meetings, quality management activities and educational programs as required.
  
  
6. Comply with Laguna Healthcare Corporation policies and procedures.
  
  
**7. Demonstrate and comply with LHC values:** COMPASSION, HONESTY, ACCOUNTABILITY, RESPECT AND TRUST.
  
  
8. Maintain a valid, insurable driver’s license.
  
  
TRIBAL PREFERENCE
  
  
LHC will apply “Indian Preference” as an employment criterion and not a “racial classification.” The Laguna Healthcare Corporation has implemented a Tribal Preference in Employment Policy. Pursuant to this Policy, applicants who possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities required by this position, and who are enrolled members of the Pueblo of Laguna will be given primary preference in hiring and employment for this position. Members of other Federally recognized Indian Tribes will be given secondary preference for hiring and employment after providing proof of Tribal membership.
  
  
CONFIDENTIALITY
  
  
All employees must fully uphold all principles of confidentiality. This position will have access to sensitive information and a breach of these principles will be grounds for immediate termination
  
  
BACKGROUND INVESTIGATION
  
  
This position may be subject to a criminal history background check, a suitability background check and/or a credit report check. In addition, some positions are subject to a more extensive background check to ensure compliance with Public Law 101-630 Indian Child Protection and Family Violence Prevention Act. Candidates must be able to successfully pass all required background checks to qualify for this position.
  
  
DRUG SCREENING
  
  
All applicants must successfully pass a pre-employment drug screening prior to beginning employment and will be subject to random drug testing
  
  
**Disclaimer:** The information on this position description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performance by employees in this position. It is not designed to contain, or be interpreted as, a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this position. Employees will be asked to perform other duties as needed.

**Job Description**

**General Summary:**

The Senior Director, Device Quality provides strategic Quality leadership and oversight for Vertex device and combination product operations across development, manufacturing, testing, clinical, commercial, and post-market activities.

The role is accountable for **risk-based operational Quality oversight of internal activities and external partners** , including CDMOs, testing laboratories, and critical suppliers. The role ensures compliance with **ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 14971** , and applicable global device and combination product requirements.

The Senior Director serves as the **Management Representative for the Device QMS** , providing leadership for QMS effectiveness, regulatory compliance, management review, inspection readiness, and continual improvement. The role partners with senior Quality and business leaders on **enterprise Quality initiatives** .

  

**Key Duties and Responsibilities:**

• Define and execute the **Device Operational QA strategy** aligned with business, portfolio, and product priorities.

• Provide Quality oversight of **CDMOs, suppliers, testing laboratories, and other external partners** , including quality agreements, audits, performance, and risk management.

• Provide Quality oversight of **internal design control, design transfer, manufacturing, testing, and product realization activities** .

• Serve as **Management Representative** for the Device QMS, ensuring QMS effectiveness, management review, compliance, and continual improvement.

• Ensure compliance with **ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 14971** , and applicable global regulatory requirements.

• Provide strategic oversight of **deviations, investigations, CAPA, change control, complaints, supplier quality, audits, and inspection readiness** .

• Establish and monitor **Quality metrics, risks, trends, and performance** , driving timely escalation and resolution of significant issues.
